source: "We now have 4-month-old mice that are non-diabetic that used to be diabetic," he added.

source: Like some other experts, he is skeptical about whether diabetes can be cured, noting that these findings have no relevance to people who already have Type 1 diabetes.

source: On Monday, Sara Danius, permanent secretary of the Nobel Committee for Literature at the Swedish Academy, publicly announced during a radio program on Sveriges Radio in Sweden the committee, unable to reach Bob Dylan directly about winning the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, had abandoned its efforts to reach him.

source: Danius said, "Right now we are doing nothing. I have called and sent emails to his closest collaborator and received very friendly replies. For now, that is certainly enough."

hypothesis: Laporan ini sangat kritis terhadap hampir setiap aspek dari kebijakan eksekutif saat ini terhadap Irak dan mendesak perubahan arah segera.

source: First among its 78 recommendations is that a new diplomatic initiative should be taken before the end of this year to secure Iraq’s borders against hostile interventions and to re-establish diplomatic relations with its neighbors.
reference: Papadahan pamulaan matan 78 papadahannya ngitu kalo sabuting inisiatip diplumatik hanyar saharusnya diambil sabalum pahabisan tahun ini gasan ma’amanakan parbatasan Irak malawan campur tangan musuh wan jua mambangun pulang raitan diplumatik wan nagara tatangganya.
hypothesis: Nang partama di antara 78 rekomendasi adalah bahwa inisiatif diplomatik hanyar harus diambil sabalum akhir tahun ini gasan maamanakan parbatasan Irak dari intervensi musuhan wan mambangun hubungan diplomatik lawan tatangganya.

source: Current senator and Argentine First Lady Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner announced her presidential candidacy yesterday evening in La Plata, a city 50 kilometers (31 miles) away from Buenos Aires.
reference: Angguta senat nang wahini wan jua Ibu Negara Argentina Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner mahabarakan pancalunan presiden sidin samalam di La Plata, kota nang bajarak 50 kilumitir (31 mil) matan Buenos Aires.
hypothesis: Senator wayah ini wan Wanita Pertama Argentina Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner mangumumakan pencalonan presiden sidin semalam malam di La Plata, kota 50 kilometer (31 mil) jauhnya dari Buenos Aires.

source: Mrs. Kirchner announced her intention to run for president at the Argentine Theatre, the same location she used to start her 2005 campaign for the Senate as member of the Buenos Aires province delegation.
reference: Nyunyah Kirchner mahabarakan tujuan sidin jadi presiden di Teater Argentina, wadah nang sama lawan pas sidin bakampanye bahari di tahun 2005 gasan mancalun jadi angguta senat parwakilan prupinsi Buenos Aires.
hypothesis: Ny. Kirchner mangumumakan niatnya gasan mancalonakan diri sabagai presiden di Teater Argentina, wadah nang sama sidin pakai gasan mamulai kampanye 2005 gasan Senat sabagai anggota delegasi provinsi Buenos Aires.

source: The debate was sparked by controversy over spending on relief and reconstruction in the wake Hurricane Katrina; which some fiscal conservatives have humorously labeled "Bush's New Orleans Deal."
reference: Hualan dipicu ulih parsalisihan pangaluaran gasan balanja wan parbaikan imbah kana Badai Katrina; nang mana babarapa urang-urang kauangan nang tuha manyambat ini tu "Parjanjian New Orleans Bush"
hypothesis: Perdebatan itu dipancarkan oleh kontroversi soal belanja bantuan dan rekonstruksi pas badai Katrina; yang oleh beberapa konservatif fiskal dengan lucu dicap sebagai "Kesepakatan New Orleans Bush".

source: Liberal criticism of the reconstruction effort has focused on the awarding of reconstruction contracts to perceived Washington insiders.
reference: Karitik liberal sual usaha pambangunan ulang nang bapokus ka pambarian kuntrak pambangunan ulang gasan bubuhan urang dalam Washington.
hypothesis: Kritik liberal dari upaya rekonstruksi difokuskan pada pemberian kontrak rekonstruksi kepada orang dalam Washington.

source: Over four million people went to Rome to attend the funeral.
reference: Labih ampat juta urang tulakan ka Roma gasan mandatangi pamakaman.
hypothesis: labih dari ampat juta urang datang ke Roma gasan menghadiri pemakamannya.

source: The number of people present was so large that it was not possible for everybody to gain access to the funeral in St. Peter's Square.
reference: Jumlah urang nang datang banyak banar sampai urang kada cagaran kawa masuk ka dalam pamakaman di St. Peter’s Square.
hypothesis: Jumlah urang nang hadir sangat banyak sahinggo kada mungkin gasan sabarataan urang masuk ka acara panguburan di Lapangan Santo Petrus.

source: Several large television screens were installed in various places in Rome to let the people watch the ceremony.
reference: Babarapa tipi balayar ganal dipasang dibamacam-macam wadah supaya urang kawa maliat upacaranya.
hypothesis: Beberapa layar televisi ganal dipasang di berbagai tempat di Roma gasan membiarkan urang-urang manonton upacara.

source: In many other cities of Italy and in the rest of the world, particularly in Poland, similar setups were made, which were viewed by a great number of people.
reference: Di babarapa kota di Italia wan balahan dunia nang lain, tarutama di Pulandia, diulah pangaturan nang sama, diliati urang dalam jumlah nang banyak banar.
hypothesis: Di banyak kota lain di Italia wan di dunia, tarutama di Polandia, panampilan nang sama diulah, nang dilihat oleh banyak urang.

source: Historians have criticized past FBI policies for focusing resources on cases which are easy to solve, especially stolen car cases, with the intent of boosting the agency's success rate.
reference: Sejarawan mangaritik kabijakan-kabijakan FBI tadahulu nang bapokus ka kasus-kasus nang nyaman digawi, hususnya kasus maling mubil, bamaksud gasan maningkatakan angka kabarhasilan.
hypothesis: Sejarawan mengkritik kebijakan FBI sebelumnya karena memfokuskan sumber daya pada kasus yang mudah dipecahkan, terutama kasus mobil curian, dengan maksud meningkatkan tingkat keberhasilan agensi.

source: Congress began funding the obscenity initiative in fiscal 2005 and specified that the FBI must devote 10 agents to adult pornography.
reference: Kungris mulai mangumpulakan insiatip kacarutan di tahun 2005 wan husus FBI harus mamokusakan 10 agennya gasan pornograpi dewasa.
hypothesis: Kongres mulai mendanai inisiatif cabul di tahun fiskal 2005 dan menetapkan bahwa FBI harus mendedikasikan 10 agen gasan pornografi dewasa.

source: Robin Uthappa made the innings highest score, 70 runs in just 41 balls by hitting 11 fours and 2 sixes.
reference: Robin Uthappa mancitak skor inning paningginya, 70 kali run baya pakai 41 bal wan manapak 11 kali angka ampat wan 2 kali angka anam.
hypothesis: Robin Uthappa mancapai skor tertinggi babak, 70 run dalam 41 bola lawan 11 kali ampat lawan 2 kali anam.

source: Middle order batsmen, Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid, performed well and made a hundred-run partnership.
reference: Pamain tangah manyuruh panapak, Sachin Tendulkar wan Rahul Dravid, bamain baik wan maulah ratusan run.
hypothesis: Pamain pukulan urutan tangah, Sachin Tendulkar wan Rahul Dravid, bamain baik wan maulah kamitraan saratus run.

source: But, after losing the captain's wicket India only made 36 runs loosing 7 wickets to end the innings.
reference: Tapi, imbah kahilangan kapten panjaga gawang India mancitak 36 kali run kahilangan 7 ja gasan manuntungakan inning.
hypothesis: Tapi, imbah kalah lawan gawang kapten India hanya maulah 36 run kalah lawan 7 gawang gasan manutup babak.

source: U.S. President George W. Bush arrived in Singapore the morning of November 16, beginning a week-long tour of Asia.
reference: Presiden Amerika Serikat George W. Bush sampai di Singapura tanggal 16 November pagi, mamulai tur Asianya samingguan.
hypothesis: Presiden AS George W. Bush sampai di Singapura pas pagi tanggal 16 November, mamulai tur sa-minggu di Asia.

source: He was greeted by Singapore's Deputy Prime Minister Wong Kan Seng and discussed trade and terrorism issues with the Singapore Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong.
reference: Sidin disambut ulih Pawakilan Pardana Mantri Wong Kan Seng wan bapapanderan parihal pardagangan jua tiruris lawan Pardana Mantri Singapura Lee Hsien Loong.
hypothesis: Sidin disambut oleh Wakil Perdana Menteri Singapura Wong Kan Seng wan badiskusi masalah perdagangan wan terorisme lawan Perdana Menteri Singapura Lee Hsien Loong.

source: After a week of losses in the midterm election, Bush told an audience about the expansion of trade in Asia.
reference: Imbah samingguan mahilang di tangah-tangah pamilihan, Bush mamadahi ka umum sual parluasan pardagangan ka Asia.
hypothesis: Imbah saminggu kalah dalam pamilihan paruh waktu, Bush bapandir lawan panontonnya soal ekspansi pardagangan di Asia.

source: Prime Minister Stephen Harper has agreed to send the government's 'Clean Air Act' to an all-party committee for review, before its second reading, after Tuesday's 25 minute meeting with NDP leader Jack Layton at the PMO.
reference: Pardana Mantri Stephen Harper sudah manyatujui gasan mangirim UU Udara Barasih ka sabarataan anggota komite partai gasan dipariksa ba’asa, sabalum pambacaan kadua, imbah partamuan salawas 25 menit hari Salasa lawan pamimpin NDP Jack Layton di PMO.
hypothesis: Perdana Menteri Stephen Harper setuju gasan mangirim 'Undang-Undang Udara Bersih' pamarintah ke panitia berataan partai gasan ditinjau, sabalum pambacaan kadua, imbah pertemuan 25 menit Selasa lawan pemimpin NDP Jack Layton di PMO.

source: Layton had asked for changes to the conservatives' environmental bill during the meeting with the PM, asking for a "thorough and complete rewriting" of the Conservative party's environmental bill.
reference: Layton sudah mancatu parubahan gasan rancangan undang-undang lingkungannya kunserpatif pas batamuan lawan Pardana Mantri, mancatu supaya "malihat wan manuntungakan ba’asa" rancangan undang-undang lingkungan partai Kunserpatif.
hypothesis: Layton minta parubahan di RUU lingkungan konservatif pas partamuan lawan PM, minta "panulisan ulang nang tuntas wan lengkap" RUU lingkungan partai Konservatif.

source: Ever since the Federal Government stepped in to take over funding of the Mersey hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, the state government and some federal MPs have criticised this act as a stunt in the prelude to the federal election to be called by November.
reference: Mulai ngitu Pamarintahan Federal ma’ambil alih pandanaan rumah sakit Mersey di Devonport, Tasmania, pamarintahan nagara wan babarapa angguta parlemen federal sudah mangaritik pargarakan ngini sabagai aksi pamulaan di pamilihan federal nang dilaksana’akan di bulan Nopember.
hypothesis: Sejak Pamarintah Federal masuk gasan maambil alih dana matan Rumah Sakit Mersey di Devonport, Tasmania, pamarintah negara bagian wan babarapa anggota parlemen federal mangkritik tindakan ngini sabagai aksi awal gasan pemilihan federal nang akan disambat pada bulan November.

source: But Prime Minister John Howard has said the act was only to safeguard the facilities of the hospital from being downgraded by the Tasmanian government, in giving an extra AUD$45 million.
reference: Tapi, Pardana Mantri John Howard sudah manyambat sikap nitu babaya gasan ma’amanakan pasilitas rumah sakit biar kada manurun kualitasnya ulih pamarintahan Tasmania, pambarian dana tambahan sabanyak 45 juta dular Australia.
hypothesis: Tapi Perdana Menteri John Howard sudah menyambat tindakan itu hanya gasan melindungi fasilitas rumah sakit dari diturunakan oleh pemerintah Tasmania, dalam mambari tambahan AUD$45 juta.

source: According to the latest bulletin, sea level readings indicated a tsunami was generated. There was some definite tsunami activity recorded near Pago Pago and Niue.
reference: Badasarakan habar paling hanyar, pangamatan parmukaan laut manunjukakan tsunami maningkat. Ada babarapa aktipitas tsunami nang tarekam di parak Pago Pago wan Niue.
hypothesis: Manurut buletin tarakhir, bacaan parmukaan laut manunjukakan tsunami diulah.

source: No major damage or injuries have been reported in Tonga, but power was temporarily lost, which reportedly prevented Tongan authorities from receiving the tsunami warning issued by the PTWC.
reference: Kadada karusakan atawa luka sarius nang dihabarakan di Tonga, tapi kahilangan daya samantara waktu nang mangalihakan pihak barwenang Tonga gasan manarima paringatan tsunami ulih PTWC.
hypothesis: Kadada karusakan ganal atawa luka-luka nang dilaporakan di Tonga, tapi listrik hilang samantara, nang dilaporakan ma'ulah otoritas Tonga kada manarima peringatan tsunami nang dikaluarakan PTWC.

source: Fourteen schools in Hawaii located on or near coastlines were closed all of Wednesday despite the warnings being lifted.
reference: Ampat belas sakulahan di Hawaii nang baandak atawa baparakan lawan garis pantai sabarataannya pas hari Arba ditutup sampai habar paringatan dicabut.
hypothesis: Ampat balas sekolah di Hawaii nang baandak di atawa parak garis pantai ditutup sabarataan hari Rabu biarpun paringatan ditarik.

source: U.S. President George W. Bush welcomed the announcement.
reference: Presiden Amerika Serikat George W. Bush manyambut baik habar ngitu.
hypothesis: Presiden AS George W. Bush menyambut baik pengumuman itu.

source: Bush spokesman Gordon Johndroe called North Korea's pledge "a major step towards the goal of achieving the verifiable denuclearization of the Korean peninsula."
reference: Jubir Bush Gordon Johndroe manyambat janji Korea Utara "sabuah langkah ganal gasan tujuan pancapaian dinuklirisasi di samananjung Korea."
hypothesis: Juru bicara Bush Gordon Johndroe manyambat janji Korea Utara "sabuting langkah ganal manuju tujuan mancapai denuklirisasi di semenanjung Korea".

source: The tenth named storm of the Atlantic Hurricane season, Subtropical Storm Jerry, formed in the Atlantic Ocean today.
reference: Badai kasapuluh musim Badai Angin Ribut Atlantik, Badai Subtrupis Jerry, ada di Samudera Atlantik hari ni.
hypothesis: Badai nang dingarani kasapuluh musim Badai Atlantik, Badai Subtropis Jerry, tabantuk di Samudra Atlantik hari ini.

source: The National Hurricane Center (NHC) says that at this point Jerry poses no threat to land.
reference: Pusat Badai Angin Ribut Nasiunal (NHC) manyambat bahuwa pada ka’adaan wahini Jerry kadada manimbulakan ancaman ka daratan.
hypothesis: Pusat Badai Nasional (NHC) menyambat bahwa pas ini Jerry kada jadi ancaman gasan daratan.

source: The U.S. Corps of Engineers estimated that 6 inches of rainfall could breach the previously damaged levees.
reference: Parsatuan Insinyur Amerika Serikat manangguhi bahuwa curah hujan 6 inci kawa manambus tanggul nang sudah rusak sabalumnya.
hypothesis: Korps Insinyur AS mangira-ngira bahwa hujan 6 inci kawa malanggar tanggul nang sudah rusak sabalumnya.

source: The Ninth Ward, which saw flooding as high as 20 feet during Hurricane Katrina, is currently in waist-high water as the nearby levee was overtopped.
reference: Ninth Ward, nang banjirnya satinggi 20 kaki salawas Badai Angin Ribut Katrina, wahini katinggian banyunya sapinggang nang mana tanggul nang parak situ sudah limpuar.
hypothesis: Kacamatan Kasambilan, nang malihat banjir satinggi 20 kaki salawas Badai Katrina, wayah ini dalam banyu satinggi pinggang lantaran tanggul paraknya sudah dilampaui.

source: Water is spilling over the levee in a section 100 feet wide.
reference: Banyunya limpas pada tanggul saluas 100 kaki.
hypothesis: Banyu sudah malalui tanggul di bagian nang lebarnya 100 kaki.

source: Commons Administrator Adam Cuerden expressed his frustration over the deletions when he spoke to Wikinews last month.
reference: Admin Umum Adam Cuerden manunjukakan kasarekannya tarhadap panghapusan pas inya bapander lawan Wikinews bulan kamarian.
hypothesis: Administrator Commons Adam Cuerden mangungkapakan rasa frustrasinya atas panghapusan pas sidin bapandir lawan Wikinews bulan lalu.

source: "He [Wales] basically lied to us from the start. First, by acting as if this was for legal reasons. Second, by pretending he was listening to us, right up to his art deletion."
reference: "Inya [Wales] tuh badusta dah matan pamulaan wan kami. Partama, bapiragah ini nih gasan alasan nang rasmi. Kadua, bapura-pura mandangarakan apa jar kami, sampai ka panghapusan."
hypothesis: "Sidin [Wales] pada dasarnya badusta lawan kami matan awal. Partama, dengan baperan seolah-olah ini gasan alasan legal. Kadua, dengan bapura-pura sidin mandangar kami, sampai ke panghapusan seni sidin".

source: The community irritation led to current efforts to draft a policy regarding sexual content for the site which hosts millions of openly-licensed media.
reference: Kajingkilan masyarakat mangarah ka usaha wayah ini gasan manyusun kabijakan parihal seksual gasan situs nang mawadahi jutaan media.
hypothesis: Iritasi komunitas manyabapakan upaya wayah ini gasan manyusun kebijakan manganai isi seksual gasan situs nang manyadiakan jutaan media berlisensi terbuka.

source: The work done was mostly theoretical, but the program was written to simulate observations made of the Sagittarius galaxy.
reference: Gawiannya sabagian ganal barupa tiuritis, tapi prugramnya ditulis maulah tiruan pangamatan galaksi Sagitarius.
hypothesis: Karya nang digawi kebanyakan teoritis, tapi programnya ditulis gasan mensimulasikan pengamatan nang digawi di galaksi Sagitarius.

source: The effect the team was looking for would be caused by tidal forces between the galaxy's dark matter and the Milky Way's dark matter.
reference: Epek nang dicari tim bisa ja disababakan ulih pasang surut antara materi kadap galaksi wan materi kadap Bimasakti.
hypothesis: Efek nang dicari tim kena disebabkan oleh gaya pasang antara materi gelap galaksi lawan materi gelap Bima Sakti.

source: Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy.
reference: Nangkaya bulan manjuhut bumi, nang manyababakan pasang surut, kaya itu jua Bimasakti mamakai kakuatan ka galaksi Sagitarius.
hypothesis: Sama kaya bulan mengerahkan tarikan di bumi, menyebabkan pasang surut, begitu jua Bima Sakti mengerahkan gaya pada galaksi Sagitarius.

source: The scientists were able to conclude that the dark matter affect other dark matter in the same way regular matter does.
reference: Buhan panaliti kawa manyimpulakan materi kadap mamangaruhi materi kadap lainnya pakai cara nang sama.
hypothesis: Para ilmuwan mampu menyimpulkan bahwa materi gelap mempengaruhi materi gelap lainnya dengan cara yang sama seperti materi biasa.

source: This theory says that most dark matter around a galaxy is located around a galaxy in a kind of halo, and is made of lots of small particles.
reference: Tiuri ngini manyambat bahuwa kabanyakan materi kadap di sakitar galaksi barada di sakitar galaksi dalam bantuk bulatan cahaya, wan taulah matan partikel-partikel halus.
hypothesis: Teori ini mengatakan bahwa sebagian besar materi gelap di sekitar galaksi terletak di sekitar galaksi dalam semacam lingkaran, dan terbuat dari banyak partikel kecil.

source: Television reports show white smoke coming from the plant.
reference: Habar tipi manampaiakan asap putih kaluar matan pabrik.
hypothesis: Lapuran televisi manunjukakan asap putih datang matan pabrik.

source: Local authorities are warning residents in the vicinity of the plant to stay indoors, turn off air-conditioners and not to drink tap water.
reference: Patugas satampat mahinggur ka warga nang barada di sakitaran pabrik supaya di rumah haja, kada manyalai AC wan kada nginum banyu ledeng.
hypothesis: Panguasa lokal manyaranakan warga di sakitar pabrik gasan tatap di dalam rumah, matiakan AC wan kada minum banyu paip.

source: According to Japan's nuclear agency, radioactive caesium and iodine has been identified at the plant.
reference: Badasarakan lembaga nuklir japang, bahan radiuaktip caesium wan iodine sudah dikatahui di daerah pabrik.
hypothesis: Ujar agensi nuklir Jepang, cesium wan yodium radioaktif sudah diidentifikasi di pabrik.

source: Authorities speculate that this indicates that containers holding uranium fuel at the site may have ruptured and are leaking.
reference: Patugas nang barwenang manduga bahuwa ada manunjukakan kabucuran panampung nang mamuat uranium.
hypothesis: Pihak berwenang berspekulasi bahwa ini menandakan bahwa wadah wadah bahan bakar uranium di lokasi mungkin telah pecah dan bocor.

source: Dr. Tony Moll discovered the Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) in the South African region KwaZulu-Natal.
reference: Dr. Tony Moll manamuakan Tuberkolosis (XDR-TB) nang taguh lawan ubat di Afrika Salatan daerah KwaZulu-Natal.
hypothesis: Dr. Tony Moll manamuakan Tuberkulosis nang Tahan Ubat (XDR-TB) di wilayah Afrika Selatan KwaZulu-Natal.

source: In an interview, he said the new variant was "very highly troubling and alarming because of the very high fatality rate."
reference: Dalam sabuah wawancara, sidin manyambat pariasi hanyar ini "liwar mambahayakan wan mahawatirakan sabab liwar patal."
hypothesis: Dalam sabuting wawancara, sidin menyambat varian hanyar "sangat meulah bingung wan meulah takutan karana tingkat kematian nang tinggi banar".

source: Some patients might have contracted the bug in the hospital, Dr. Moll thinks, and at least two were hospital health workers.
reference: Babarapa pasien mungkin sudah manyebarakan pirusnya di rumah sakit, Dr. Moll bapikir, wan paling kada ada dua patugas kasehatan.
hypothesis: Beberapa pasien mungkin kena virus di rumah sakit, Dr. Moll bapikir, wan paling kada dua adalah petugas kesehatan rumah sakit.

source: In one year's time, an infected person may infect 10 to 15 close contacts.
reference: Dalam satahunan, urang nang tatular kawa manularakan ka 10 sampai 15 urang dalam jarak nang parak.
hypothesis: Dalam waktu satahun, sasaurang nang tainfeksi kawa manyabarakan 10 sampai 15 kontak parak.

source: However, the percentage of XDR-TB in the entire group of people with tuberculosis still seems to be low; 6,000 of the total 330,000 people infected at any particular moment in South Africa.
reference: Tapi, parsentasi XDR-TB di saluruh kalumpuk urang nang ada tuberkolosis masih randah; 6.000 matan 330.000 urang nang tatular di Afrika Selatan.
hypothesis: Namun, persentase XDR-TB dalam seberataan kelompok urang nang baisi tuberkulosis masih tampak randah; 6.000 dari total 330.000 urang nang terinfeksi pas wayah tertentu di Afrika Selatan.

source: The satellites, both of which weighed in excess of 1,000 pounds, and traveling at approximately 17,500 miles per hour, collided 491 miles above the Earth.
reference: Satelit nang barat kaduduanya labih dari 1.000 pon wan nang kelajuannya kira-kira 17.500 mil par jam, baranjahan 491 mil pas di atas bumi.
hypothesis: Satelit, nang badua baratnya labih matan 1.000 pon, wan bajalan lawan kecepatan sakitar 17.500 mil per jam, barumpak 491 mil di atas Bumi.

source: Scientists say the explosion caused by the collision was massive.
reference: Buhan panaliti manyambat bahwa latupan nang diulah imbah beranjahan tu ganal banar.
hypothesis: Buhan ilmuwan menyambat ledakan nang disebabkan oleh tabrakan itu ganal banar.

source: They are still trying to determine just how large the crash was and how the Earth will be affected.
reference: Buhannya masih mamparkira’akan sa’apa gonolnya tabrakan tadi wan jua kayapa kaina epeknya ka bumi.
hypothesis: Buhannya masih mencoba gasan menentuakan seberapa ganal tabrakan itu wan kayapa Bumi akan terpengaruh.

source: The United States Strategic Command of the U.S. Department of Defense office is tracking the debris.
reference: Kantor Komando Strategis Amerika Serikat matan Departemen Pertahanan AS lagi mencari’i bakas raruntuhannya.
hypothesis: Komando Strategis Amerika Serikat dari kantor Departemen Pertahanan AS melacak puing-puing.

source: The result of plotting analysis will be posted to a public website.
reference: Hasil analisisnya kaina ditampaiakan akan di website umum.
hypothesis: Hasil analisis plot akan diunggah ke situs web umum.

source: A doctor who worked at Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania will be charged with aggravated murder after her mother was found dead in the trunk of her car Wednesday, authorities in Ohio say.
reference: Saurang duktur nang bagawi di Rumah Sakit Anak Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania cagaran didakwa atas pambunuhan barat imbah mamanya kadapatan mati di dalam bagasi mubilnya hari Arba, jar pihak nang barwenang di Ohio.
hypothesis: Saurang dokter nang bagawi di Rumah Sakit Anak Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania akan dituduh lawan pembunuhan nang parah imbah mamanya ditamuakan mati di bagasi mobilnya Rabu, ujar otoritas di Ohio.

source: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, was found in Blue Ash, Ohio, a suburb approximately 15 miles north of Cincinnati lying on the ground beside the road in a T-shirt and underwear in an apparently heavily medicated state.
reference: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29 tahun, ditamuakan di Blue Ash, Ohio, daerah pinggiran 15 mil bagian utara Cincinnati haratan barabah di pinggir jalan baya mamakai baju kaus wan basempakan ja dalam kaadaan dipangaruhi ubat.
hypothesis: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29 tahun, ditamuakan di Blue Ash, Ohio, sabuah pinggiran kota sakitar 15 mil utara Cincinnati baring di tanah di pinggir jalan pakai baju T wan pakaian dalam dalam keadaan nang talihat banyak mamakai obat.

source: She directed officers to her black Oldsmobile Intrigue which was 500 feet away.
reference: Inya manunjukakan wan patugas ka mubilnya nang tapisah sajauh 500 kaki.
hypothesis: Sidin manyuruh petugas ka Oldsmobile Intrigue hitamnya nang bajarak 150 meter.

source: There, they found the body of Saroja Balasubramanian, 53, covered with blood-stained blankets.
reference: Di sana, bubuhan patugas manamuakan mayat Saroja Balasubramanian, 53 tahun nang ditukupi pakai salimput babakas darah.
hypothesis: Di sana, bubuhannya manamuakan mayat Saroja Balasubramanian, 53, tatutup lawan selimut badarah.

source: Police said that the body appeared to have been there for about a day.
reference: Pulisi manyambat mayatnya tuh sudah sakitar saharian ada di sana.
hypothesis: Polisi bapadah awaknya sudah ada disana sahari.

source: The first cases of the disease this season were reported in late July.
reference: Kasus partama wabah di musim ini dihabarakan pas akhir Juli.
hypothesis: Kasus panyakit nang partama musim ini dilaporakan pas akhir Juli.

source: The show originally featured amateur voice actors, local to East Texas.

hypothesis: Acara ngini awalnya menampilkan aktor suara amatir, lokal ke Texas Timur.

source: Widespread looting reportedly continued overnight, as law enforcement officers were not present on Bishkek's streets.
reference: Panjarahan maluas tarus balanjut sapanjang malam, Kadada patugas panagak hukum nang barada di jalan Bishkek.
hypothesis: Panjambretan nang luas dilaporakan tarus tarus samalam, lantaran petugas penegak hukum kadada di jalanan Bishkek.

hypothesis: Bishkek digambarakan sabagai mandalam ka dalam keadaan "anarki" oleh saurang pangamat, sabagai geng urang bajalan di jalanan wan marampok toko barang konsumsi.

source: Several Bishkek residents blamed protesters from the south for the lawlessness.
reference: Babarapa panduduk Bishkek manyalahakan pandemo matan salatan atas palanggaran hukum.
hypothesis: Babarapa panduduk Bishkek manyalahkan para demonstran dari selatan atas pelanggaran hukum.

source: South Africa have defeated the All Blacks (New Zealand) in a rugby union Tri Nations match at the Royal Bafokeng Stadium in Rustenburg, South Africa.

hypothesis: Afrika Selatan mangalahakan All Blacks (Selandia Hanyar) dalam partandingan rugby union Tri Nations di Stadion Royal Bafokeng di Rustenburg, Afrika Selatan.

source: The final score was a one-point victory, 21 to 20, ending the All Blacks' 15 game winning streak.
reference: Hasil akhirnya kamanangan satu angka, 21-20, ma’akhiri kamanangan 15 kali baruntunnya All Blacks.

source: For the Springboks, it ended a five-match losing streak.

hypothesis: Gasan Springboks, itu maakhiri lima kali kalah baruntun.

source: It was the final match for the All Blacks, who had already won the trophy two weeks ago.

source: No immediate reports of damage have been received by the United States Geological Survey (USGS) and its National Earthquake Information Center.

source: The strain of bird flu lethal to humans, H5N1, has been confirmed to have infected a dead wild duck, found on Monday, in marshland near Lyon in the east of France.

source: As a result, the performers smoke cannabis joints on stage, and the theatre itself is encouraging the audience to join in.

source: Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich, Texas governor Rick Perry, and Congresswoman Michele Bachmann finished in fourth, fifth, and sixth place, respectively.

source: The photographer was transported to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he subsequently died.

source: According to police, the driver of the vehicle that hit the photographer is unlikely to face criminal charges.

source: With only eighteen medals available a day, a number of countries have failed to make the medal podium.

source: UN peacekeepers, whom arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake, are being blamed for the spread of the disease which started near the troop's encampment.
reference: Pasukan panjaga pardamaian PBB, datang ka Haiti imbah gempa bumi 2010, ditiwasakan karana manyabarakan panyakit nang mana dimulai parak serobong tantara.
hypothesis: Pasukan penjaga perdamaian PBB, nang tiba di Haiti imbah gempa bumi 2010, disalahkan gasan penyebaran penyakit nang dimulai di parak perkemahan pasukan.

source: According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest.
reference: Ujar parkara, limbah matan berserobong PBB itu kada tapi dibarasihi, ma’ulah bakteri masuk ka anak sungai Artibonite, salah satu sungai targanal di Haiti.
hypothesis: Ujar gugatan, limbah dari kamp PBB kada disanitasi dengan baik, manyababakan bakteri masuk ke anak sungai Sungai Artibonite, salah satu sungai terbesar di Haiti.

source: Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s.
reference: Sabalum kadatangan tantara, nagara Haiti kada suah bamasalah nang bahubungan panyakit itu tumatan 1800an.
hypothesis: Sabalum kadatangan pasukan, Haiti kada pernah manamuakan masalah nang bakaitan lawan panyakit ngini sajak 1800-an.

source: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti.
reference: Institut Haiti sagan Keadilan wan Demokrasi babulik ka kapada panalitian indipinden nang manyatakan bahuwa batalyon pasukan panjaga pardamaian PBB dari Nepal kada sadar mambawa panyakit nitu ka Haiti.
hypothesis: Institut Keadilan dan Demokrasi Haiti sudah marujuk studi independen nang manunjukakan batalyon penjaga perdamaian PBB Nepal tanpa sadar mambawa penyakit ke Haiti.

source: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.
reference: Danielle Lantagne, saurang ahli panyakit dari PBB, manyambat bahuwa panyakit ini manyabar karna pasukan panjaga pardamaian PBB.
hypothesis: Danielle Lantagne, ahli PBB soal panyakit, manyatakan wabahnya kamungkinan disababakan oleh pasukan penjaga perdamaian.

source: Hamilton confirmed Howard University Hospital admitted the patient in stable condition.

hypothesis: Hamilton mengkonfirmasi Rumah Sakit Universitas Howard menerima pasien dalam kondisi stabil.

source: The patient had been to Nigeria, where some cases of the Ebola virus have occurred.

source: The hospital has followed protocol for infection control, including separating the patient from others to prevent possible infection of others.

source: During the 1980s he worked on shows such as Taxi, Cheers, and The Tracy Ullman Show.

source: In 1989 he helped create The Simpsons with Brooks and Groening, and was responsible for hiring the show's first writing team.

source: Despite leaving the show in 1993 he kept the title of executive producer, and continued to receive tens of millions of dollars every season in royalties.

hypothesis: Sabalumnya kantor berita Cina Xinhua malaporakan sabuah pasawat dibajak.

source: Aerosmith have cancelled their remaining concerts on their tour.

source: Potro received treatment to his shoulder at this point but managed to return to the game.

source: Out of 1,400 people polled prior to the 2010 federal election, those who oppose Australia becoming a republic grew by 8 per cent since 2008.

source: At the extremes of the poll, 29 per cent of those surveyed believe Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31 per cent believe Australia should never become a republic.

source: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.
reference: Roda sudah maubah dunia sacara mankjubakan. Hal paling penting nang sudah digawi roda gasan kita yato mambari kita banyak kamudahan wan angkutan nang labih laju.
hypothesis: Roda sudah meubah dunia dengan cara nang luar biasa. Hal paling ganal nang roda sudah lakukan gasan kita adalah memberikan kita transportasi nang jauh lebih mudah wan lebih hancap.

source: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.
reference: Roda sudah mambawakan kita kureta, mutur, wan banyak angkutan nang lain.
hypothesis: Ini sudah mambawa kita ka kereta api, mobil, wan banyak alat transportasi lainnya.

source: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.
reference: Di bawah buhannya ada kucing nang ukuran sadang nang mamakan mangsa baukuran sadang matan kalinci sampai ka kancil wan rusa.
hypothesis: Di bawah buhannya ada kucing baukuran labih manangah nang mamakan mangsa baukuran manangah mulai matan arnab sampai antelop wan rusa.

source: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.
reference: Akhirnya, ada banyak kucing halus (tamasuk kucing inguan balapas) nang mamakan jauh labih baragam mangsa halus nang kaya sarangga, binatang pangarat, kadal, wan burung.
hypothesis: Ahirnya, ada banyak kucing halus (tamasuk kucing peliharaan nang bebas) nang mamakan mangsa halus nang jauh labih banyak kaya serangga, tikus, kadal, wan burung.

source: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.
reference: Rahasia kabarhasilannya yato konsep lekung, sabuting gawian nang istimiwa nang kucing baisi ngitu matan basaing wan nang lain.
hypothesis: Rahasia keberhasilan buhannya adalah konsep niche, gawian khusus nang dimiliki satiap kucing nang ma'ulah buhannya kada bersaing lawan nang lain.

source: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
reference: Singa ngitu kucing nang paling basosial, badiam di kalumpuk ganal nang disambat kawanan.
hypothesis: Singa adalah kucing nang paling sosial, hidup dalam kalompok ganal nang disambat kawanan.

source: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
reference: Kawanan tabantuk matan sabuting sampai talu targantung jantan ganal, lawan sampai talu puluh batina wan anak-anaknya.
hypothesis: Kalompok tadiri matan satu sampai talu jantan dewasa nang bakaitan, baimbai lawan sakitar talu puluh binian wan anak-anaknya.

source: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
reference: Nang batina rajin tu parak saikung lawan saikung, manjadi kaluarga ganal matan kaka-ading wan anak babini.
hypothesis: Bibinian biasanya bakarabat parak satu sama lain, jadi keluarga ganal nang tadiri matan ading wan anak binian.

source: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
reference: Kawanan singa baaksi nangkaya kawanan sarigala atawa hadupan, binatang nang handak sama kaya singa (tapi lain kucing) dalam hal batingkah, wan juwa mamatikan banar ka mangsanya.
hypothesis: Singa nang bakawanan bagawi kaya kawanan serigala atawa anjing, binatang nang kaya singa (tapi kada kucing ganal lainnya) dalam kalakuan, wan jua bisa mati gasan mangsanya.

source: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.
reference: Saurang atlit nang saraba bisa, macan kawa banaik-naik (maski kada lihai), bakunyung, malacung jarak jauh wan manjuhut lima kali labih kuat daripada kakuatan manusia.
hypothesis: Atlit nang baik, harimau kawa mandaki (maskipun kada baik), bakunyung, maluncat jarak jauh wan manarik lawan lima kali kakuatan manusia nang kuat.

source: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.
reference: Macan ngitu ada di kalumpuk nang sama (Gen Panthera) nang kaya singa, macan tutul, wan jaguar. Ampat kucing ngini haja nang kawa maraung.
hypothesis: Harimau tamasuk dalam kalompok (Genus Panthera) nang sama lawan singa, macan tutul, wan jaguar.

source: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.
reference: Raungan macan kada sapanuh kaya ampun singa, tapi labih nang kaya kalimat garaman, kuriakan kata-kata.
hypothesis: Raungan harimau kada kaya raungan singa, tapi labih kaya kalimat kata-kata nang kasar, diteriakan.

source: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.
reference: Ocelot katuju makan binatang halus. Inya cagar manangkap warik, ular, binatang pangarat, wan burung kalo inya kawa. Handak sabarataan binatang nang Ocelot buru ngitu jauh labih halus daripada dirinya.
hypothesis: Ocelot suka mamakan binatang halus. inya kawa manangkap monyet, ular, tikus wan burung amun kawa. hampir sabarataan binatang nang diburu ocelot jauh labih halus daripada inya.

source: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.
reference: Buhan ilmuwan bapikir kalo ocelot maumpati wan mandapati binatang gasan dimakan (dimangsa) malalui bau, manciumi di mana buhannya barada di atas tanah.
hypothesis: Buhan ilmuwan bapikir bahwa ocelot maumpati wan manamukan binatang gasan dimakan (mangsa) lawan baulah, manghirup gasan manamuakan wadah buhannya di tanah.

source: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
reference: Inya kawa malihat dengan jalas dalam kadap lawan panglihatan malam, wan bagarak diam-diam, juwa. Ocelots mamburu mangsanya pakai cara basambunyi di sakitaran imbah tu marungkau mangsanya.
hypothesis: Buhannya kawa malihat baik banar di dalam kalam lawan panglihatan malam, wan bajalan halus banar jua. Ocelot mamburu mangsanya lawan bagabung lawan lingkungan buhannya imbahtu manyarang mangsanya.

source: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
reference: Pas kalumpuk halus makhluk hidup (dalam populasi halus) tapisah matan pupulasi utamanya wadahnya baasal (misalnya inya pindah ka wilayah pagunungan atawa sungai, atawa kalau inya pindah ka pulau hanyar jadi inya ngalih handak babulik) inya cagar rancak marasa ada wadah nang balain matan nang buhannya dahulu.
hypothesis: Pas sakalompok halus makhluk hidup (populasi halus) tapisah matan populasi utama nang asalnya (kaya bila inya bapindah malalui pagunungan atawa sungai, atawa bapindah ka pulau hanyar sahingga inya kada kawa pulang) inya rancak akan manamukan diri di lingkungan nang balain matan sabalumnya.

source: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
reference: Lingkungan nang hanyar ngini baisi sumber nang balain wan pasaing nang balain, jadi populasi hanyar cagar parlu sifat nang balain atawa manyasuaiakan manjadi pasaing labih kuat daripada apa nang buhannya parlu sabalumnya.
hypothesis: Lingkungan hanyar ini baisi sumber daya nang balain wan pesaing nang balain, jadi populasi hanyar akan mamarluakan fitur atawa adaptasi nang balain gasan jadi pesaing nang kuat daripada apa nang diparluakan sabalumnya.

source: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.
reference: Populasi awal balum barubah sama sakali, ngitu masih parlu panyasuaian nang sama kaya sabalumnya.
hypothesis: Populasi asli kada baubah sama sekali, buhannya masih butuh adaptasi nang sama kaya sabalumnya.

source: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.
reference: Waktu balalu, populasi hanyar mulai manyasuaiakan ka lingkungan hanyarnya, buhannya mulai kurang mehatiakan wan kurang katuju wan populasi nang lain.
hypothesis: Seiring waktu, pas populasi hanyar mulai beadaptasi lawan lingkungan hanyar buhannya, buhannya mulai kada tapi mirip lawan populasi nang lain.

source: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
reference: Padahal lah, ribuan atawa jutaan tahun nang lalu, dua populasi cagar talihat balain banar nang mana buhannya kada kawa disambat matan spesies nang sama.
hypothesis: Akhirnya, setelah ribuan atau bahkan jutaan tahun, kedua populasi akan terlihat sangat berbeda sehingga mereka tidak dapat disebut spesies yang sama.

source: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
reference: Kami manyambatnya ngini proses manspesialkan, nang cuma baarti mambantuk spesies hanyar. Panspesialan ialah konsekuensi nang kada kawa diabaiakan wan bagian nang penting banar matan evolusi.
hypothesis: Spesiasi marupakan akibat nang kada kawa dihindari wan bagian penting matan evolusi.

source: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).
reference: Tanaman maulah oksigen nang dihiyut manusia, wan buhannya maambil karbondioksida nang dihambusakan manusia (ngitu pang, bahinak).
hypothesis: Tumbuhan meulah oksigen nang dihirup manusia, wan buhannya mengambil karbon dioksida nang dihirup manusia (yaitu, mengembuskan napas).

source: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.
reference: Tanaman maulah makanannya surang matan matahari malalui fotosintesis. Buhannya juwa manyadiakan kanaungan.
hypothesis: Tumbuhan maulah makanan buhannya matan matahari malalui fotosintesis. Buhannya jua manyadiaakan naungan.

source: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.
reference: Kami maulah rumah kami pakai tanaman wan maulah baju pakai tanaman. Kabanyakan makanan nang kami makan ngitu tanaman-tanaman. Kadeda tanaman, binatang-binatang kada kawa batahan.
hypothesis: Kita maulah rumah matan tumbuhan wan baju matan tumbuhan. Kabanyakan makanan nang kita makan adalah tumbuhan. Tanpa tumbuhan, satua kada kawa batahan hidup.

source: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
reference: Mosasaurus marupakan pamangsa puncak di masanya, jadi inya kada takut apa haja, kacuali mosasaurus lainnya.
hypothesis: Mosasaurus adalah predator puncak pada zamannya, jadi kada takutan lawan apa-apa, kacuali mosasaurus nang lain.

source: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
reference: Rahangnya nang panjang bahambur wan labih matan 70 gigi nang landap nang kaya silit, diumpati wan saparangkat tambahan di langit-langit muntungnya, nang baarti bahuwa kadada jalan kaluar gasan apa haja nang malalui jalannya.
hypothesis: Rahang panjangnya ditumbuhi labih dari 70 gigi tajam, lawan tambahan satu set di langit-langit mulutnya, artinya kadada jalan gasan apa haja nang melintasinya.

source: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
reference: Kita kada tahu pasti, tagal natu mungkin baisi ilat nang bacabang. Makanannya tamasuk kura-kura, iwak ganal, mosasaurus nang lain, wan natu bahkan bisa jadi kanibal.
hypothesis: Kita kada tahu pasti, tapi bisa jadi inya baisi lidah bercabang. makanannya tamasuk kura-kura, iwak ganal, mosasaurus lainnya, dan mungkin jua kanibal.

source: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
reference: Natu jua manyarang apa haja nang masuk ka banyu, bahkan dinusaurus ganal nang kaya T. rex kada bakal sabanding lawan natu.
hypothesis: Inya jua manyarang apa haja nang masuk ka banyu; bahkan dinosaurus raksasa kaya T. rex kada kawa malawaninya.

source: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse
reference: Biar kabanyakan makanannya talihat sama gasan kita, buhan Rumawi gin baisi hidangan aneh atawa kada biasa, tamasuk babi hutan, burung marak, ular, wan sajanis binatang pangarat di sambat durmus
hypothesis: Samantara kabanyakan makanan buhannya kawa dikenal lawan kita, urang Romawi baisi makanan nang aneh atawa kada biasa, tamasuk babi hutan, merak, siput, wan jenis tikus nang disambat tikus tidur

source: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.
reference: Parbidaan lainnya pas urang miskin wan binian mamakan makanannya sambil duduk di kursi, lakian sugih katuju ma’adakan jamuan ba-sama-sama nang mana buhannya barabah di higa makanannya sambil mamakan makanan buhannnya.
hypothesis: Parbedaan lain adalah bahwa urang miskin wan biniannya makan sambil duduk di kursi, urang sugih suka maulah pesta basamaan di mana buhannya duduk sambil makan.

source: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.
reference: Makanan Rumawi bahari kada mamasukakan makanan nang barasal matan Eropa matan Amerika atawa matan Asia di abad dudi-dudi.
hypothesis: Makanan Romawi kuno kada mungkin tamasuk makanan nang datang ke Eropa dari Amerika atawa dari Asia pada abad-abad salanjutnya.

source: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.
reference: Umpamanya, buhannya kada baisian jagung, atawa tumat, atawa kantang, atawa cuklat, wan kadada Rumawi bahari nang suah marasai daging kalkun.
hypothesis: Misalnya, buhannya kada baisi jagung, atawa tomat, atawa kentang, atawa kakao, wan kada ada urang Romawi kuno nang pernah marasai kalkun.

source: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.
reference: Buhan Babilonia maulahakan masing-masing dewanya sabuah kuil nang diparcaya sabagai rumah dewa ngitu.
hypothesis: Urang Babilonia mambangun kuil utama gasan masing-masing dewa buhannya nang dianggap sabagai rumah dewa.

source: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.
reference: Urang-urang mambawa sasaji gasan dewa-dewa ngitu lalu pandita maurusi kabutuhan dewa-dewa ngitu lawan maadaakan upacara-upacara wan pestipal-pastipal.
hypothesis: Urang-urang mambawa kurban gasan dewa-dewa wan para imam bausaha gasan mancapai kabutuhan dewa-dewa malalui upacara wan festival.

source: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.
reference: Satiap kuil baisi halaman kuil nang tabuka wan sabuting wadah karamat di dalam nang pandita haja kawa masuk.
hypothesis: Masing-masing kuil baisi halaman nang tabuka wan wadah suci nang hanya bisa dimasuki imam.

source: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.
reference: Takananya piramida husus babantuk manara, dingarani ziggurat, diulah gasan jadi bagian kuil.
hypothesis: Kadang-kadang manara khusus nang babantuk piramid, disambat ziggurat, dibangun sabagai bagian dari kuil.

source: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
reference: Bagian atas manara ngitu wadah suci gasan si dewa.
hypothesis: Puncak manara adalah wadah suci khusus gasan dewa.

source: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.
reference: Iklim hangat di Timur Tangah, rumah kada tapi penting.
hypothesis: Di iklim nang hangat di Timur Tengah, rumah kada penting banar.

source: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.
reference: Kabanyakan kahidupan kaluarga Ibrani balangsung di udara tabuka.
hypothesis: Kabanyakan kahidupan keluarga Ibrani terjadi di udara terbuka.

source: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.
reference: Buhan binian bamasak di halaman; tuku-tuku buka mahadap langsung ka jalan. Batu dipakai gasan maulah rumah-rumah.
hypothesis: Wanita nang bamasak di halaman; toko-toko hanyalah loket tabuka nang malihat ka jalan. Batu dipakai gasan mambangun rumah.

source: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.
reference: Kadada hutan-hutan nang ganal di banua Kanaan, jadi kayu haraganya larang banar.
hypothesis: Kadada hutan ganal di tanah Kanaan, jadi kayu larang banar.

source: Greenland was settled sparsely. In the Norse sagas they say that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when travelling further west, found Greenland and named it Greenland.
reference: Greenland jarang didiami. Di kesah-kesah Norse buhannya manyambat bahuwa Erik Si Habang dibuang matan Islandia sabab mambunuh, wan wayah haratan batulakan jauh ka barat, manamukan Greenland imbah tu mangarani ngitu Greenland.
hypothesis: Greenland tadapat populasi nang langka. Dalam saga Norse, jar Erik si Merah dibuang matan Islandia karana mambunuh, wan pas bajalanan labih ka barat, inya manamuakan Greenland wan mangarani Greenland.

source: But regardless of his discovery, Eskimo tribes were already living there at the time.
reference: Tagal kaya apa haja panamuannya, suku Eskimo sudah badiam di sana wayah ngitu.
hypothesis: Tapi kada paduli panamuannya, suku Eskimo sudah hidup di sana pas waktu itu.

source: Though each country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, kings, customs and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.
reference: Biar masing-masing nagara adalah 'urang Skandinavia', ada banyak parbidaan antara rakyat, buhan raja, baju-baju, wan sajarah matan Denmark, Swedia, Norwegia, wan Islandia.
hypothesis: Walaupun masing-masing negara adalah 'Skandinavia', ada banyak perbedaan antara rakyat, raja, adat istiadat dan sejarah Denmark, Swedia, Norwegia dan Islandia.

source: If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.
reference: Amun ikam manuntun pelem National Treasure, ikam luku bapikir peta harta karun ditulis dibalakang Diklarasi Kamardikaan.
hypothesis: kalo kalian pernah nonton film National Treasure, kalian mungkin berpikir peta harta karun ditulis di belakang Declaration of Independence.

source: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.
reference: Katia, ngini tu kada bujur. Biar ada sapalih nang ditulis dibalakang dukumen, ngini tu lain pita harta karun.
hypothesis: Tapi, itu kada bujur. walaupun ada tulisan di balakang dokumen, itu lain peta harta karun.

source: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.
reference: Nang tatulis di balakang Diklarasi Kamardikaan ngitu kata-kata "Diklarasi Kamardikaan Asli tanggal 4 Juli 1776". Bacaannya ada di bawah dukumen, tatulis tabalik.
hypothesis: Ditulis di balakang Deklarasi Kemerdekaan adalah kata-kata "Deklarasi Kemerdekaan Asli tanggal 4 Juli 1776". Teksnya muncul di bagian bawah dokumen, terbalik.

source: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.
reference: Biar kadada nang tahu siapa nang manulis, dikatahui pas hahanyaran ngini tu ada, dukumin perkamen ganal ngitu (ganalnya 29¾ inci kali 24½ inci) digulung gasan disimpani.
hypothesis: Walaupun kadada nang tahu pasti siapa nang manulisnya, tapi nang diketahui bahwa pas awal kehidupannya, dokumen perkamen ganal (ukuran 293⁄4 inci lawan 241⁄2 inci) digulung gasan disimpan.

source: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.
reference: Makanya, ngini tu nangkaya catatan nang ditambahi haja gasan label.
hypothesis: Jadi, kamungkinan bahwa notasi ditambahkan hanya sebagai label.

source: The D-Day landings and the following battles had freed the north of France, but the south still wasn't free.
reference: Hari-H pandaratan wan partampuran barikutnya sudah malapasakan Prancis bagian utara, tagal nang di salatan masih balum dilapas.
hypothesis: Pendaratan D-Day wan pertempuran salanjutnya sudah mambebasakan utara Perancis, tapi selatan masih balum bebas.

source: It was ruled by the "Vichy" French. These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders instead of fighting them.
reference: Ngini diatur "Vichy" Prancis. Urang-urang Prancis ngini nang badamai wan buhan Jerman di tahun 1940 imbah tu bagawi wan buhan panyarbu katimbang bakalahi lawan buhannya.
hypothesis: itu dikuasai oleh "Vichy" Perancis. ini adalah urang Perancis yang telah berdamai dengan Jerman pada tahun 1940 dan bekerja dengan penjajah daripada melawan mereka.

source: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".
reference: Pas 15 Agustus 1940, buhan Aliansi manyarbu bagian salatan Perancis, panyarbuan ngini tu bangaran "Uperasi Naga".
hypothesis: Pas 15 Agustus 1940, Sekutu manyarang Prancis selatan, invasi disambat "Operasi Dragoon".

source: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.
reference: Dalam dua minggu haja buhan Amerika wan Angkatan Pambibasan Prancis sudah malapasakan Prancis bagian salatan wan babalik mahadapi Jerman.
hypothesis: Dalam dua minggu pasukan Amerika wan pasukan Prancis Bebas sudah malapasakan Prancis selatan wan bapaling ka Jerman.

source: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
reference: Paradaban ngitu budaya tunggal nang tabagi-bagi uleh sakulumpuk ganal urang nang badiam wan bagawi baimbai sabagai masyarakat.
hypothesis: Peradaban adalah budaya tunggal nang dibagi oleh sekelompok besar urang nang hidup wan begawi secara kooperatif, masyarakat.

source: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
reference: Kata paradaban bamula dari Bahasa Latin civilis, baarti sipil, bahubungan ka Bahasa Latin civis, baarti panduduk, wan lingkungan, baarti kuta atawa nagara-kuta, wan jua kaya apapun jua mandifinisiakan ukuran masyarakat.
hypothesis: Kata peradaban berasal dari bahasa Latin civilis, artinya sipil, berhubungan dengan bahasa Latin civis, artinya warga negara, dan civitas, artinya kota atau negara kota, dan itu juga entah bagaimana mendefinisikan ukuran masyarakat.

source: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
reference: Nagara-kuta ngitu pandahulunya nagara. Budaya paradaban bearti mawarisakan pangatahuan malalui babarapa ganarasi, sabuting jajak budaya nang balangsung wan panyabaran nang marata.
hypothesis: Negara-kota adalah pendahulu bangsa-bangsa. Budaya peradaban menyiratkan penyampaian pengetahuan di beberapa generasi, jejak budaya yang bertahan dan penyebaran yang adil.

source: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
reference: Budaya halus rancak punah kadada maninggalakan bukti sajarah nang baraitan wan gagal dikatahui sabagai paradaban nang sasuai.
hypothesis: Budaya minor rancak hilang tanpa maninggalakan bukti sejarah nang relevan wan gagal diakui sebagai peradaban nang bujur.

source: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.
reference: Salawas Perang Ripulusiunir, talu welas nagara partama mambantuk sabuting kapamarintahan pusat nang lamah—lawan buhan Diwan nang manjadi sabubutingannya bagian—di bawah Pasal-Pasal Kunfidirasi.
hypothesis: Salawas Perang Kamardekaan, katigo baleh nagara bagian partamo mambantuak pamarintahan pusat nan lamah - jo Kongres sabagai satu-satunyo komponen - di bawah Pasal Konfederasi.

source: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.
reference: Diwan kurang baisi kakuatan gasan manganaakan pajak, wan, sabab kadada iksikutif nasiunal atawa buhan kahakiman, inya ma’andalakan uturitas nagara, nang rancak kada mambantu, gasan manjalanakan sabarataan undang-undangnya.
hypothesis: Kongres kada baisi kuasa gasan memaksakan pajak, wan, karena kadada eksekutif nasional atawa yudikatif, inya begantung lawan otoritas negara bagian, nang rancak kada kooperatif, gasan manjalankan seberataan tindakannya.

source: It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states.
reference: Ngini tu jua kada baisi uturitas gasan manulak paraturan pajak wan tarif antar nagara.
hypothesis: Inya jua kada baisi wewenang gasan maatasakan hukum pajak wan tarif antar negara bagian.

source: The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
reference: Pasal-pasal ngini tu parlu kasapakatan bulat matan barataan nagara sabalum buhannya di amandemen wan nagara-nagara ma’anggap inting kapamarintahan pusat nang parwakilan-parwakilan buhannya takananya absin.
hypothesis: Pasal-pasal ngini mamarluakan persetujuan barataan nagara bagian sabalum diubah wan nagara bagian maanggap pamarintah pusat ringan banar sahinggo wakilnya rancak kadada.

source: Italy's national football, along with German national football team is the second most successful team in the world and were the FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.
reference: Bal sipak nasiunal Italia, baimbaian lawan tim nasiunal Jerman ngini tu tim kadua nang paling barhasil di dunia wan jua pamanang partandingan FIFA World Cup tahun 2006.
hypothesis: Tim nasional sipak bola Italia, baimbai lawan tim nasional sipak bola Jerman adalah tim paling sukses kadua di dunia wan marupakan juara Piala Dunia FIFA 2006.

source: Popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water-polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey and F1 motor racing.
reference: Ulahraga nang dikatujui ngitu tamasuk bal sipak, bal basket, bal puli, polo-banyu, anggar, rakbi, sapidaan, huki es, huki ruda, wan balapan F1.
hypothesis: Olahraga nang populer tamasuk sepak bola, bola basket, bola voli, polo banyu, pagar, rugby, balap sepeda, hoki es, hoki roller wan balap motor F1.

source: Winter sports are most popular in the Northern regions, with Italians competing in international games and Olympic events.
reference: Ulahraga musim dingin paling dikatujui di wilayah utara, wan buhan Italia batanding di parlumbaan internasiunal wan acara Ulimpiade.
hypothesis: Olahraga musim dingin paling populer di wilayah Utara, lawan urang Italia bersaing di permainan internasional wan acara Olimpiade.

source: Japans holds nearly 7,000 islands (the biggest being Honshu), making Japan the 7th largest island in the world!
reference: Jepang maingkuti handak sampai 7,000 kapulauan (pangganalnya Honshu), maulah Jepang manjadi pulau ka-7 pangganalnya di dunia!
hypothesis: Japang baisi parak 7.000 pulau (nang pangganalnya adalah Honshu), nang ma'ulah Japang pulau pangganalnya ka-7 di dunia!

source: Due to the cluster/group of islands Japan has, Japan is often referred to, on a geographical stance, as an "archipelago"
reference: Disababakan sakalumpuk pulau nang ampun Jepang, Jepang rancak disambat, sacara giugrapi, sabagai "kapulauan"
hypothesis: Marga kalompok pulau nang dimiliki Japang, Japang rancak disambat sabagai "kapulauan"

source: Taiwan beginning start way back in 15th century where European sailors passing by record the island’s name as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island.
reference: Taiwan bamula pas abad 15 nang mana buhan palaut Eropa maliwatinya imbah tu mancatat ngaran pulau sabagai Ilha Formosa atawa pulau nang bengkeng.
hypothesis: Taiwan bamula baasal matan abad ka-15 di mana palaut Eropa nang lewat mancatat ngaran pulau ngitu sabagai Ilha Formosa, atawa pulau nang indah.

source: In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations.
reference: Di tahun 1624, Parusahaan Welanda Timur India baulah sabuting pangkalan di bagian barat daya Taiwan, mamulai parubahan dalam palaksanaan baulah gandum aburigin wan manggawiakan buruh Cina gasan manggawi pananaman baras wan gula.
hypothesis: Pas tahun 1624, Parusahaan Hindia Timur Belanda mambangun sabuah markas di barat daya Taiwan, mamulai parubahan dalam praktik produksi gandum urang adat wan manggunaakan buruh Cina gasan bagawi di perkebunan beras wan gula.

source: In 1683, Qing dynasty (1644-1912) forces take control of Taiwan’s western and northern coastal areas and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885.
reference: Di tahun 1683, pasukan dinasti Qing (1644-1912) manguasai bagian barat Taiwan wan bagian utara parak pantai wan ma’akui Taiwan sabagai Prupinsi Kakaisaran Qing di 1885.
hypothesis: Pado 1683, pasukan dinasti Qing (1644-1912) manguasai wilayah pasisia barat jo utara Taiwan dan manyatokan Taiwan sabagai provinsi Kakaisaran Qing pado 1885.

source: In 1895, after defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it cedes sovereignty over Taiwan to Japan, which rules the island until 1945.
reference: Di tahun 1895, imbah kakalahan Perang Sino-Jepang partama (1894-1895), kapamarintahan Qing maneken Parsatujuan Shimonoseki, nang mana mambariakan kadaulatan Taiwan ka Japang, nang mamarintah pulau sampai tahun 1945.
hypothesis: Pas 1895, imbah kalah dalam Perang Tiongkok-Jepang Pertama (1894-1895), pamarintah Qing manandatangani Perjanjian Shimonoseki, nang mana inya manyarahakan kedaulatan atas Taiwan ka Jepang, nang manguasai pulau itu sampai 1945.

source: Machu Picchu consist of three main structures, namely Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.
reference: Macchu Picchu tardiri matan tiga struktur utama, yaitu Intihuatana, Kuil Matahari, wan Kamar Tiga Jandila.
hypothesis: Machu Picchu tadiri matan talu struktur utama, yaitu Intihuatana, Kuil Matahari, wan Kamar Tiga Jendela.

source: Most of the buildings on the edges of the complex have been rebuilt in order to give tourists a better idea of how they originally appeared.
reference: Kabanyakan gadung di bagian pinggir kumplek sudah diulah ba’asa gasan mambari buhan turis gambaran nang labih bagus kaya apa bantuk sabujurnya.
hypothesis: Kabanyakan bangunan di pinggir komplek sudah dibangun pulang gasan mambariakan wisatawan gambaran nang labih baik tentang kaya apa bangunan-bangunan ngini awalnya.

source: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and restoration continues till today.
reference: Di tahun 1976, tiga puluh pirsin Macchu Picchu sudah dibaiki wan parbaikannya balanjut sampai wayah ini.
hypothesis: Pas tahun 1976, 30% dari Machu Picchu sudah dibaiki wan restorasi tarus dilanjutakan sampai wahini.

source: For example, the most common still image photography format in the world is 35mm, which was the dominant film size at the close of the analog film era.
reference: Umpamanya, bantuk gambar putugrapi nang paling umumnya masih 35mm, nang mana ukuran duminan pelem wayah pahabisan jaman pelem analok.
hypothesis: Misalnya, format fotografi gambar diam nang paling umum di dunia adalah 35mm, nang merupakan ukuran film dominan di akhir era film analog.

source: It is still produced today, but more importantly its aspect ratio has been inherited by digital camera image sensor formats.
reference: Ngini tu masih diulah sampai wayah ini, tagal labih pentingnya lagi rasiu aspiknya sudah diturunakan ka bantuk sinsur gambar kamira digital.
hypothesis: Itu masih diulah sampai wahini, tapi nang labih penting rasio aspeknya sudah diwarisi oleh format sensor gambar kamera digital.

source: The 35mm format is actually, somewhat confusingly, 36mm in width by 24mm in height.
reference: Bantuk 35mm sabujurnya, pina mambingungakan, libarnya 36mm wan tingginya 24mm.
hypothesis: Format 35mm sabujurnya, agak bingung, 36mm lebar lawan 24mm tinggi.

source: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2.
reference: Aspik rasiu bantuk ngini (tarbagi dua balas gasan nyaman mandapati rasiu angka kasuluruhan) makanya disambat manjadi 3:2.
hypothesis: Rasio aspek format ini (dibagi dua belas gasan mendapatkan rasio bilangan bulat paling sederhana) oleh karena itu dikatakan 3: 2.

source: Many common formats (APS family of formats, for example) are equal to or closely approximate this aspect ratio.
reference: Banyak bantuk nang biasa (cuntuhnya bantukan kaluarga APS) sama aja atawa labih parak mamparkirakan rasiu aspek ngini.
hypothesis: Banyak format umum (keluarga format APS, misalnya) sama lawan atau mendekati rasio aspek ini.

source: The much-abused and often-ridiculed rule of thirds is a simple guideline creating dynamism while keeping a measure of order in an image.
reference: Talu aturan nang banyak disalahgunaakan wan rancak dihuluti yato arahan gampang maulah dinamisme wayah manjaga pangukuran urutan sabuting gambar.
hypothesis: Aturan sepertiga nang banyak disalahgunakan wan rancak diada-akan adalah pedoman sederhana nang meulah dinamika sambil menjaga ukuran urutan dalam gambar.

source: It states that the most effective place for the main subject is at the intersection of lines dividing the image into thirds vertically and horizontally (see example).
reference: Ngini manyambat bahuwa wadah nang paling ipiktip gasan subjek utama yato pasimpangan garis-garis nang mambagi gambar jadi talu bagian sacara tagak lurus wan mandatar (lihati cuntuh).
hypothesis: Dinyatakan bahwa wadah nang paling efektif gasan subjek utama adalah di persimpangan garis nang mambagi gambar jadi tiga secara vertikal wan horizontal (lihat contoh).

source: During this period of European history, the Catholic Church, which had become rich and powerful, came under scrutiny.
reference: Selama periode sejarah Eropa ngini, Gereja Katolik, nang sudah jadi sugih wan bekuasa, mendapat sorotan.
hypothesis: Salawas periode ngini dari sajarah Eropa, Gereja Katolik, nang sudah jadi sugih wan kuat, mulai dipantau.

source: For over a thousand years the Christian religion had bound European states together despite differences in language and customs. I
reference: Selama lebih dari seribu tahun agama Kristen sudah meikat negara-negara Eropa beimbai walaupun ada beda bahasa wan adat istiadat. I
hypothesis: Salawas labih dari saribu tahun agama Kristen sudah maikat nagara-nagara Eropa basamaan walaupun ada perbedaan bahasa wan adat istiadat.

source: Its all-pervading power affected everyone from king to commoner.
reference: Kekuatannya nang mencakup sabarataan mempengaruhi sabarataan urang dari raja sampai urang biasa.
hypothesis: Kekuatannya nang luas banar mempengaruhi setiap urang dari raja sampai rakyat jelata.

source: One of the main Christian tenets is that wealth should be used to alleviate suffering and poverty and that the monetary funds of the church are there specifically for that reason.
reference: Salah satu prinsip utama buhan Kristen adalah bahwa kekayaan harus dipakai gasan meringan akan pesakitan wan kemiskinan wan bahwa dana moneter gereja ada gasan alasan ngitu.
hypothesis: Salah satu prinsip utama Kristen adalah bahwa kekayaan harus digunakan untuk mengurangi penderitaan dan kemiskinan dan bahwa dana moneter gereja ada secara khusus untuk alasan itu.

source: The central authority of the church had been in Rome for over a thousand years and this concentration of power and money led many to question whether this tenet was being met.
reference: Otoritas pusat gereja sudah ada di Roma selawas lebih dari saribu tahun wan pemusatan kekuasaan wan duit ngini meolah banyak urang menakun akan apakah prinsip ngini tepenuhi.
hypothesis: Otoritas pusat gereja sudah ada di Roma selama lebih dari seribu tahun dan konsentrasi kekuasaan dan uang ini menyebabkan banyak yang mempertanyakan apakah prinsip ini terpenuhi.

source: Soon after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain initiated a naval blockade of Germany.
reference: Limbah pacahnya parmusuhan, Inggris mulai mamblukir jalan laut Jerman.
hypothesis: Kada lawas imbah pecahnya perang, Inggris mamulai blokade laut Jerman.

source: The strategy proved effective, cutting off vital military and civilian supplies, although this blockade violated generally accepted international law codified by several international agreements of the past two centuries.
reference: Rancana ngini diakui ampuh, mamagat parsadiaan penting kamilitiran wan panduduk, biar pahalangan nginih malanggar paraturan intarnasiunal tarsusun nang disatujui babarapa parjanjian intarnasiunal di dua abad pahabisan.
hypothesis: Strategi ngini tabukti efektif, mamotong pasokan militer wan sipil nang panting, walaupun blokade ngini malanggar hukum internasional nang diterima umum dikodifikasi oleh beberapa perjanjian internasional dua abad nang lalu.

source: Britain mined international waters to prevent any ships from entering entire sections of ocean, causing danger to even neutral ships.
reference: Inggris mamasang ranjau parairan intarnasiunal gasan mahalau kapal-kapal apa ja nang mamasuki kasaluruhan bagian samudera, manyababakan bahaya ka bahkan kapal nang kada mamihak.
hypothesis: Inggris menambang di perairan internasional gasan mencegah kapal masuk ke seluruh bagian lautan, menyebabkan bahaya bahkan bagi kapal netral.

source: Since there was limited response to this tactic, Germany expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare.
reference: Hadian ngitu ada balasan tarbatas gasan rancana nginih, Jerman mangangira balasan nang sama ka kapal salam perangnya nang kada dibatasi.
hypothesis: Karena ada tanggapan nang tabatas gasan taktik ngini, Jerman maharap tanggapan nang sama gasan perang kapal selamnya nang kada dibatasi.

source: During the 1920s, the prevailing attitudes of most citizens and nations was that of pacifism and isolation.
reference: Salawas tahun 1920-an, sikap kuat kabanyakan masyarakat wan nagara-nagara yato pasifisme wan pamisahan.
hypothesis: Salawas tahun 1920an, sikap nang paling umum di kabanyakan warga wan nagara adalah pasifisme wan isolasi.

source: After seeing the horrors and atrocities of war during World War I, nations desired to avoid such a situation again in the future.
reference: Imbah malihat kangarian wan kakajaman perang salawas Perang Dunia I, nagara-nagara handak maampihakan situasi nangkaya ngini lagi di dudi-dudi hari.
hypothesis: Imbah malihat horor wan kekejaman perang salawas Perang Dunia I, bangsa-bangsa handak menghindari situasi kaya itu lagi di masa depan.

source: In 1884, Tesla moved to the United States of America to accept a job with the Edison Company in New York City.
reference: Tahun 1884, Tesla pindah ka Amerika Serikat gasan maambil gawian di Edison Company di Kuta New York.
hypothesis: Pas tahun 1884, Tesla pindah ke Amerika Serikat gasan manarima gawian di Edison Company di New York City.

source: He arrived in the US with 4 cents to his name, a book of poetry, and a letter of recommendation from Charles Batchelor (his manager in his previous job) to Thomas Edison.
reference: Inya sampai ka Amerika Serikat wan pamikirannya, sabuting buku puisi, wan surat saran matan Charles Batchelor (menejer inya nang di gawian tadahulu) gasan Thomas Edison.
hypothesis: Sidin datang ke Amerika Serikat lawan 4 sen gasan ngarannya, sabuting buku puisi, wan surat rekomendasi dari Charles Batchelor (manajernya di gawian sabalumnya) gasan Thomas Edison.

source: Ancient China had a unique way of showing different time periods; each stage of China or each family that was in power was a distinctive dynasty.
reference: Cina bahari baisi cara unik gasan manampaiakan parbedaan waktu; tiap jaman di Cina atawa tiap kaluarga nang bakuasa nitu dinasti nang barbeda.
hypothesis: Cina kuno baisi cara unik gasan manunjukakan periode waktu nang balainan; satiap tahap di Cina atawa satiap kaluarga nang berkuasa adalah dinasti nang khas.

source: Also between each dynasty was an unstable age of divided provinces. The best-known of these periods was the Three Kingdoms epoch taking place for 60 years between the Han and the Jin Dynasty.
reference: Wan jua antara tiap dinasti nih jaman parpacahan prupinsi nang kada stabil. Nang paling tarkanalnya tu jaman Talu Karajaan nang balangsung salawas 60 tahun antara dinasti Han wan dinasti Jin.
hypothesis: Di antara masing-masing dinasti ada jua zaman kada stabil nang dibagi jadi paropinsi. nang paling terkenal dari periode ini adalah zaman Tiga Kerajaan nang berlangsung selama 60 tahun antara Dinasti Han wan Dinasti Jin.

source: During these periods fierce warfare took place between many nobles fighting for the throne.
reference: Salawas jaman-jaman ngini paparangan sengit malibatakan bubuhan bangsawan nang marabutakan tahta.
hypothesis: Salawas periode nginih, perang nang garang terjadi antara banyak bangsawan nang berjuang gasan tahta.

source: The Three Kingdoms was one of the bloodiest eras in Ancient China’s history thousands of people died fighting to sit in the highest seat in the grand palace at Xi’an.
reference: Talu Karajaan ngini tu salh sabuting jaman paling badarah di sajarah Cina Bahari ribuan urang nang mati marabutakan gasan manduduki kursi tartinggi di kakaisaran di Xi’an.
hypothesis: Tiga Kerajaan adalah salah satu era paling berdarah dalam sejarah Cina Kuno ribuan urang mati berjuang gasan duduk di kursi paling tinggi di istana agung di Xian.

source: There are a lot of social and political effects such as the use of metric system, a shift from absolutism to republicanism, nationalism and the belief the country belongs to the people not to one sole ruler.
reference: Ada banyak pangaruh susial wan pulitik nangkaya pamakaian tataan metrik, parpindahan matan absulutisme ka ripublik, nasiunalisme wan kayakinan bahuwa nagara tu ampun rakyat kada gasan panguasa tunggal.
hypothesis: Ada banyak efek sosial dan politik seperti penggunaan sistem metrik, pergeseran dari absolutisme ke republikanisme, nasionalisme dan keyakinan bahwa negara milik rakyat bukan satu penguasa tunggal.

source: Also after the Revolution occupations were open to all male applicants allowing the most ambitious and successful to succeed.
reference: Wan jua imbahnya Ripulusi gawian tarbuka gasan samunyaan pandaptar lakian mamungkinakan nang paling ba’ambisi wan barhasil gasan malanjutakan.
hypothesis: Imbah Revolusi jua, gawian tabuka gasan sabarataan lalakian nang malamar, nang mamungkinakan nang paling ambisius wan sukses gasan bahasil.

source: Same goes for the military because instead of army rankings being based on class they were now based on cailaber.
reference: Sama nangkaya militer, wahini paringkat tantara badasarakan kamampuan, kada lagi badasarakan kalas.
hypothesis: Nang sama jua gasan militer karena alih-alih pangkat militer berdasarkan kelas mereka sekarang didasarkan pada kaliber.

source: The French Revolution also inspired many other repressed working class people of other country's to began their own revolutions.
reference: Ripulusi Prancis jua manaladani banyak bubuhan kalas pekerja nang tartindas di nagara lain gasan mamulai ripulusi bubuhannya surang.
hypothesis: Revolusi Perancis jua menginspirasi banyak kelas pekerja lain yang ditekan di negara lain untuk memulai revolusi mereka sendiri.

source: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation.
reference: Muhammad tatarik banar wan parihal nang di luar kaduniawian. Sidin rancak ka guha nang limbah tu bangaran ‘Hira” di atas Gunung “Noor” (cahaya) gasan bapikir.
hypothesis: Muhammad sangat tertarik lawan hal-hal di luar kehidupan duniawi ini. sidin rancak bakunjang ke sebuah gua nang dikenal sebagai Hira di Gunung Noor (cahaya) gasan kontemplasi.

source: he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations.
reference: Sidin bahaluwat surangan, tahan bahari-hari, nang mambari gambaran jalas kahandak ruhani Sidin.
hypothesis: Gua itu sorang, nang batahan sampai wahini, mambari gambaran nang jelas banar tentang kecenderungan spiritual Muhammad.

source: Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world.
reference: Baistirahat di atas salah satu pagunungan subalah utara Makkah, guha ngitu taisolasi banar matan dunia luar.
hypothesis: Baandak di puncak salah sabuting gunung di utara Makkah, guha ngini talalu tapisah matan dunia luar.

source: In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. Once inside the cave, it is a total isolation.
