reference: Sabujurnya, ngalih banar mancarinya padahal sudah tahu andakannya. Sakali masuk ka dalam sana, dasar bujuran ta’asingakan.
hypothesis: Bahkan, kada nyaman gasan ditamuakan bahkan amun ada nang tahu adanya.

source: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
reference: Kadada nang kawa dilihat salain, langit nang langkar wan barasih wan dikulilingi banyak pagunungan. Sadikit banar nang kawa dilihat wan didangar matan dalam guha.
hypothesis: Kadada nang kawa dilihat selain langit nang jernih wan indah di atas wan banyak gunung di sakitarnya.

source: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only one of the seven wonders that is still standing today.
reference: Piramida Agung di Giza ngitu salah sabuting tujuh kaajaiban dunia nang masih badiri sampai wahini.
hypothesis: Piramida Agung di Giza adalah sabutingannya dari tujuh keajaiban dunia nang masih badiri sampai wahini.

source: Built by the Egyptians in the third century BCE, the Great Pyramid is one of many large pyramid structures built to honor dead Pharaoh.
reference: Diulag ulih urang-urang Mesir di abad katalu Sabalum Masihi, Piramida Agung ngitu salah sabuting banyak bangunan-bangunan piramida ganal nang diulah gasan mahurmati Pharaoh nang mati.
hypothesis: Dibangun oleh urang Mesir pada abad ketiga SM, Piramida Agung adalah salah satu dari banyak struktur piramida besar nang dibangun gasan menghormati Firaun nang sudah mati.

source: The Giza Plateau, or "Giza Necropolis" in the Egyptian Valley of the Dead contains several pyramids (of which the great pyramid is the largest), several small tombs, several temples, and the great Sphinx.
reference: Dataran Giza, atawa "Pamakaman Giza" di Lembah Kamatian Mesir baisi babarapa piramida (nang mana piramida agung nang pangganalnya), babarapa makam halus, babarapa kuil, wan Sphinx agung.
hypothesis: Dataran Tinggi Giza, atawa "Giza Necropolis" di Lembah Mati Mesir baisi babarapa piramid (nang mana piramid ganal adalah nang pangganalnya), babarapa makam halus, babarapa kuil, wan Sphinx ganal.

source: The great pyramid was created to honor the Pharaoh Khufu, and many of the smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were built to honor Khufu's wives and family members.
reference: Piramida agung diulah gasan mahurmati Pharaoh Khufu, wan banyak piramida halus, kuburan, wan kuil diulah gasan mahurmati bini-bininya Khufu wan bubuhan angguta kaluarga.
hypothesis: Piramida ganal diulah gasan mamuji Firaun Khufu, wan banyak piramida, makam, wan kuil nang labih halus diulah gasan mamuji bini wan anggota kaluarga Khufu.

source: The "up bow" mark looks like a V and the "down bow mark" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side.
reference: Ciri "up bow" kalihatan nangkaya hurup V wan ciri "down bow mark" nangkaya kawat gapit atawa kutak nang kadada bagian bawahnya.
hypothesis: Tanda "up bow" kelihatan kayak V dan "down bow mark" kayak staple atau kotak yang bagian bawahnya hilang.

source: Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow.
reference: Atas baarti ikam musti mamulai di hujungnya wan tunjul langkungannya, wan bawah baarti ikam harus mulai di frog (tangan ikam maingkuti langkungannya) wan juhut langkungannya.
hypothesis: Atas artinya ikam harus mulai di hujung wan mendorong busur, wan bawah artinya ikam harus mulai di katak (nang mana tangan ikam memegang busur) wan menarik busur.

source: An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive.
reference: Atas-bawah rancak tuh mahasilakan suara nang labih halus, kalu bawah-langkungan takuat wan tatagas.
hypothesis: Sabuah up-bow biasanya mahasilakan suara nang labih lembut, sadangkan down-bow labih kuat wan labih tegas.

source: Feel free to pencil in your own marks, but remember the printed bowing marks are there for a musical reason, so they should usually be respected.
reference: Serah haja gasan maulah ciri ikam surang, tagal ingati ciri langkungan nang ada tuh ada gasan kaparluan musik, jadi itu tu rancak harus dihatiakan.
hypothesis: Jangan ragu gasan manulis tanda-tanda Pian sorang, tapi ingat tanda-tanda basapida di sana gasan alasan musik, jadi biasanya harus dihormati.

source: The terrified King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette their two young children (11 year old Marie Therese and four year old Louis-Charles) and the King's sister, Madam Elizabeth, on the 6th October 1789 were forced back to Paris from Versailles by a mob of market women.
reference: Raja Louis XVI nang sangar, Ratu Marie Antoinette, kadua anak buhannya (Marie Therese 11 tahun wan Louis-Charles ampat tahun) wan dingsanak Raja, Madam Elizabeth, pas tanggal 6 Oktober 1789 dipaksa sagarumbulan babinian pasar gasan babulik ka Paris matan Versailles.
hypothesis: Raja Louis XVI nang takutan, Ratu Marie Antoinette dua anak halus buhannya (Marie Therese nang baumur 11 tahun wan Louis-Charles nang baumur ampat tahun) wan ading Raja, Madam Elizabeth, pada tanggal 6 Oktober 1789 dipaksa babulik ka Paris matan Versailles ulih garumbulan bibinian pasar.

source: In a carriage, they traveled back to Paris surrounded by a mob of people screaming and shouting threats against the King and Queen.
reference: Di dalam kereta, bubuhannya bulik ka Paris dikulilingi ulih sagarumbulan urang nang manguciaki wan maancam ka Raja wan Ratu.
hypothesis: Dalam sabuting kereta, bubuhannya bakunjangan bulik ka Paris dikalilingi ulih urang banyak nang basorak wan manyahuti ancaman ka Raja wan Ratu.

source: The mob of people forced the King And Queen to have their carriage windows wide open.
reference: Garumbulan tadi mamaksa Raja wan Ratu mambuka sunduk salibar-libarnya.
hypothesis: Gugup urang mamaksa Raja wan Ratu mambuka jendela kereta buhannya.

source: At one point a member of the mob waved the head of a royal guard killed at Versailles in front of the terrified Queen.
reference: Pas itu salah saikung garumbulan mangawai-ngawai kapala panjaga karajaan nang mati di Versailles ka hadapan Ratu nang katakutanan.
hypothesis: Di satu titik anggota massa melambaikan kepala penjaga kerajaan nang dibunuh di Versailles di hadapan Ratu nang takutan.

source: The war expenditures of U.S. imperialism in the conquest of the Philippines were paid for by the Filipino people themselves.
reference: Pangaluaran perang impirialisme Amerika Serikat dalam manaklukakan Filipina sudah dibayari ulih urang Filipina sorang.
hypothesis: Biaya perang imperialisme AS dalam penaklukan Filipina dibayar oleh rakyat Filipina sorang.

source: They were compelled to pay taxes to the U.S. colonial regime to defray a major part of the expenditures and the interest on bonds floated in the name of the Philippine government through the Wall Street banking houses.
reference: Buhannya dipaksa mabayari pajak ka wadah panguasa kulunial Amerika Serikat kabanyakannya gasan mambayari pangaluaran wan bunga ubligasi mangambang nang mamakai ngaran pamarintahan Filipina malalui rumah bang Wall Street.
hypothesis: Buhannya tapaksa mambayar pajak gasan rezim kolonial AS gasan menanggung sebagian ganal pengeluaran wan bunga obligasi nang dilayangakan atas ngaran pamarintah Filipina malalui rumah-rumah perbankan Wall Street.

source: Of course, the superprofits derived from the protracted exploitation of the Filipino people would constitute the basic gains of U.S. imperialism.
reference: Nang iyanya, kauntungannya maambil matan pamerasan urang Filipina nang balarut-larut ngitu pang kauntungan dasar impirialisme Amerika Serikat.
hypothesis: Tentu saja, keuntungan super nang didapat dari eksploitasi rakyat Filipina nang berkepanjangan akan menjadi keuntungan dasar imperialisme AS.

source: To understand the Templars one must understand the context that prompted the creation of the order.
reference: Gasan mamahami Templar harus paham raitan nang mandurung tabantuknya katartiban.
hypothesis: Gasan mamahami Templar urang harus mamahami konteks nang mamicu panciptaan ordo.

source: The age where the events took place is commonly referred as the High Middle Ages the period of European history in the 11th, 12th, and 13th centuries (AD 1000–1300).
reference: Jaman nang mana paristiwa-paristiwa tarjadi wayah Jaman Partangahan Tinggi wayah sajarah Eropa di abad 11, 12, wan 13 (1000-1300 Masihi).
hypothesis: Zaman dimana peristiwa-peristiwa itu terjadi umumnya disambat sebagai Abad Pertengahan Tinggi periode sejarah Eropa pada abad ke-11, ke-12, dan ke-13 (AD 10001300).

source: The High Middle Ages were preceded by the Early Middle Ages and followed by the Late Middle Ages, which by convention ends around 1500.
reference: Jaman Partangahan Tinggi bamula wan Jaman Partangan Awal imbah tu disambung Jaman Partangan Akhir, nang mana baakhir sakitar tahun 1500.
hypothesis: Abad Pertengahan Tinggi didahului oleh Abad Pertengahan Awal wan diikuti oleh Abad Pertengahan Akhir, nang menurut konvensi berakhir sekitar tahun 1500.

source: Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology.
reference: Tiknulugi determinisme marupakan istilah nang mancakup barbagai gagasan dalam praktik, matan juhungan tiknulugi atawa kaharusan tiknulugi ka nalar nang katat bahuwa takdir manusia dikandaliakan ulih lugika mandasar nang bakaitan lawan hukum ilmiah wan parwujudannya dalam tiknulugi.
hypothesis: Determinisme teknologi adalah istilah nang mencakup berbagai gagasan dalam praktik, mulai dari dorongan teknologi atau imperatif teknologi hingga arti ketat bahwa nasib manusia didorong oleh logika mendasar nang terkait lawan hukum ilmiah dan manifestasinya dalam teknologi.

source: Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has "effects" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned.
reference: Kabanyakan tapsiran matan tiknulugi determinisme babagi dua gagasan umum: bahuwa parkambangan tiknulugi natu surangan maumpati langkah nang sabagian basar ada di luar pangaruh budaya atawa pulitik.
hypothesis: "Kebanyakan interpretasi determinisme teknologi bebagi dua gagasan umum: bahwa perkembangan teknologi itu sendiri mengikuti jalan sebagian besar di luar pengaruh budaya atau politik, dan teknologi itu pada gilirannya beisi ""efek"" pada masyarakat nang bawaan, daripada dikondisikan secara sosial".

source: For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads.
reference: Cuntuhnya, urang kawa manyambat lamun kandaraan mubil pasti kawa manuntun ka parkambangan matan jalan raya.
hypothesis: Contohnya, urang kawa bapadah bahwa mobil pasti mengarah pada pengembangan jalan.

source: However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership.
reference: Tagal, jaringan jalan nasiunal naya kada layak sacara ikunumi hinggan gasan saiikit mubil, jadi mitudi pruduksi hanyar dikambangakan gasan mangurangi biaya matan kapamilikan mubil.
hypothesis: Namun, jaringan jalan nasional secara ekonomi kada layak gasan hanya segelintir mobil, jadi metode produksi hanyar dikembangakan gasan mengurangi biaya kepemilikan mobil.

source: Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies.
reference: Kapamilikan mubil masal jua manuntun ka insiden nang labih tinggi matan kacalakaan di jalan raya, nang mana manuntun ka panamuan tihnik hanyar dalam parawatan kasihatan gasan mambaiki awak nang rusak.
hypothesis: Kepemilikan mobil secara massal jua manyabapakan insiden kacilakaan nang labih tinggi di jalanan, nang manyabapakan panamuan teknik hanyar dalam perawatan kasihatan gasan mambaiki awak nang rusak.

source: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.
reference: Rumantisme baisi unsur budaya ditirminisme nang ganal, tapangaruh matan buhan panulis nangkaya Goethe, Fichte, wan Schlegel.
hypothesis: Romantisisme baisi elemen ganal determinisme budaya, nang diambil dari penulis kaya Goethe, Fichte, wan Schlegel.

source: In the context of Romanticism, the geography molded individuals, and over time customs and culture related to that geography arose, and these, being in harmony with the place of the society, were better than arbitrarily imposed laws.
reference: Dalam sual Rumantisme, giugrapi mambantuk parurangan, wan lawas kalawasan kabiasaan wan budaya baraitan lawan giugrapi ngitu muncul, wan ngini tu, manjadi salaras wan wadah masyarakat, labih baik katimbang hukum nang dipaksaakan.
hypothesis: Dalam konteks Romantisisme, geografi mambentuk individu, wan sairing waktu adat wan budaya nang bahubungan lawan geografi ngitu timbul, wan ngini, bahubungan lawan wadah masyarakat, labih baik daripada hukum nang ditarapakan sacara sewenang-wenang.

source: In the manner that Paris is known as the fashion capital of the contemporary world, Constantinople was regarded as the fashion capital of feudal Europe.
reference: Olehnya Paris dipinandui jadi ibu kota mode dunia kotemporer, Konstantinopel dianggap jadi ibu kota mode Eropa feodal.
hypothesis: Di cara Paris dikenal sebagai ibu kota mode dunia kontemporer, Konstantinopel dianggap sebagai ibu kota mode Eropa feodal.

source: Its renown for being an epicenter of luxury began in about 400 A.D. and lasted up until about 1100 A.D.
reference: Dipinandui sebagai pusat kemewahan dimulai pas sekitar 400 M wan rahatan sampai sekitar 1100 M.
hypothesis: Ketenaran sabagai pusat kemewahan dimulai sekitar tahun 400 M dan tarus ada sampai sekitar tahun 1100 M.

source: Its status declined during the twelfth century mainly due to the fact that Crusaders had returned bearing gifts such as silks and spices that were valued more than what Byzantine markets offered.
reference: Statusnya menurun selawas abad kedua belas terutama karena fakta bahwa Tentara Salib sudah kembali dengan membawa hadiah nang kayak sutra wan rempah-rempah nang benilai lebih dari apa nang ditawari akan oleh Pasar Bizantium.
hypothesis: Statusnya manurun pas abad ka-12 tarutama karana bubuhan tentara salib babulik mambawa hadiah kaya sutra wan rempah-rempah nang dihargai labih tinggi daripada pasar Bizantium.

source: It was at this time that the transfer of the title of Fashion Capital from Constantinople to Paris was made.
reference: Wayah ngitu gelar Ibu kota Mode bapindah darinya Konstantinopel ka Paris.
hypothesis: Wayah ngitu jua alihnya julukan Ibu Kota Mode dari Konstantinopel ka Paris digawi.

source: Gothic style peaked in the period between the 10th - 11th centuries and the 14th century.
reference: Gaya gutik mancapai puncaknya pas antara abad 10-11 wan abad 14.
hypothesis: Gaya Gotik mencapai puncaknya pas periode antara abad ke-10 - 11 wan abad ke-14.

source: At the beginning dress was heavily influenced by the Byzantine culture in the east.
reference: Pas pamulaan gaun dipangaruhi banar ulih budaya Brizantin di timur.
hypothesis: Pado awalnyo, pakaian dipangaruahi sacaro gadang dek budaya Bizantium di timur.

source: However, due to the slow communication channels, styles in the west could lag behind by 25 to 30 year.
reference: Katia, sabab lambatnya hubungan kumunikasi, mudil busana di barat bisa katinggalan 25 sampai 30 tahun.
hypothesis: Namun, karana saluran komunikasi nang lamban, gaya di barat kawa tertinggal 25 sampai 30 tahun.

source: towards the end of the Middle Ages western Europe began to develop their own style. one of the biggest developments of the time as a result of the crusades people began to use buttons to fasten clothing.
reference: Manuju akhir Jaman Partangahan daerah barat Eropa bamulai marangkatakan gaya buhannya surang. Salah sabuting parangkatan paling ganal disababakan perang salib, urang-urang mulai mamakai kima gasan mangancingi baju.
hypothesis: Pas akhir Abad Pertengahan Eropa Barat mulai mangambangakan gaya buhannya sorang. Salah satu parkambangan paling ganal pas ngitu adalah akibat Perang Salib. Urang mulai manggunaakan kancing gasan mangikat baju.

source: Subsistence agriculture is agriculture carried out for the production of enough food to meet just the needs of the agriculturalist and his/her family.
reference: Kahidupan partanian adalah partanian nang dijalanakan gasan maolah makanan sacukupnya haja gasan patani wan kaluarga buhannya.
hypothesis: Pertanian subsisten adalah pertanian nang dilakukan gasan produksi makanan nang cukup gasan memenuhi kebutuhan petani wan keluarganya.

source: Subsistence agriculture is a simple, often organic, system using saved seed native to the ecoregion combined with crop rotation or other relatively simple techniques to maximize yield.
reference: Kahidupan partanian sadarhana haja, labih ka alami, tataan mamakai banih simpanan asli ekoregion disatuakan wan paputaran tanaman atawa tehnik-tehnik sadarhana lainnya gasan mamaksimalakan hasilnya.
hypothesis: Pertanian subsisten adalah sistem sederhana, rancak organik, nang mamakai bibit asli ekoregion nang disimpan dikombinasikan lawan rotasi tanaman atawa teknik nang relatif sederhana lainnya gasan memaksimalkan hasil.

source: Historically most farmers were engaged in subsistence agriculture and this is still the case in many developing nations.
reference: Sajarahnya kabanyakan bubuhan patani tabuat dalam kahidupan partanian wan ngini tu masih manjadi masalah di nagara berkembang.
hypothesis: Secara historis sabagian besar petani terlibat dalam pertanian subsisten wan ini masih terjadi di banyak negara berkembang.

source: Subcultures bring together like-minded individuals who feel neglected by societal standards and allow them to develop a sense of identity.
reference: Sub-budaya mangumpulakan urang-urang nang bapikiran sama nang marasa diabaiakan lawan standar masyarakat wan maulah buhannya mangambangakan jati diri.
hypothesis: Subkultur mangumpulakan individu nang bapikir sama nang marasa kada tapi dihormati ulih standar masyarakat wan mamungkinakan buhannya gasan mangambangakan rasa identitas.

source: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.
reference: Sub-budaya kawa jadi babida sabab umur, etnis, kalas, tampat, wan/atawa janis kalamin anggutanya.
hypothesis: Subkultur kawa dibedaakan karena umur, etnis, kelas, lokasi, wan/atawa jenis kelamin anggotanya.

source: The qualities that determine a subculture as distinct may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, sexual, geographical, or a combination of factors.
reference: Kualitas nang manantuakan sub-budaya sabagai pambida ngitu bisa ja kabahasaan, estetika, kaagamaan, pulitik, siksual, wadah bagana, atawa gabungan babarapa alasan.
hypothesis: Kualitas nang menentukan subkultur nang berbeda mungkin linguistik, estetika, agama, politik, seksual, geografis, atau kombinasi faktor.

source: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashions, mannerisms, and argot.
reference: Buhan angguta sub-budaya ngini takananya mambari sinyal kaanggutaannya liwat parbidaan wan mamakai gaya gasan manciri’i, nang maliputi mudil busana, kalakuan, wan dialek.
hypothesis: Anggota subkultur rancak manandai kaanggotaan buhannya malalui gaya khas wan simbolis, nang tamasuk mode, tingkah laku, wan bahasa gaul.

source: One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up.
reference: Salah sabuting cara nang paling rancak dipakai gasan manggambarakan pentingnya basusialisasi ngitu gasan mamanapaatakan babarapa parihal kakanakan nang kurang bauntung sabab ditalantarakan, kada tapi bauntung, atawa disiksa, kada digaduhi ulih urang tuha pas buhan kakanak ngitu tumbuh.
hypothesis: Salah satu metode nang paling umum dipakai gasan manggambarakan pentingnya sosialisasi adalah dengan manggambarakan beberapa kasus nang kada baik dari anak-anak nang, karena kelalaian, kesialan, atawa pelecehan nang disengaja, kada disosialisasi oleh urang dewasa pas inya tumbuh.

source: Such children are called "feral" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment.
reference: Kakanakan nangkaya ngitu disambatnya "feral" atawa liar. Babarapa kakanakan liar suah dikurung wan urang (rancak tuh kuitannya surang) babarapa parihal kakanakan nang talantar ngini sabab kuitannya kada kawa manarima kakurangan anaknya atawa cacat pisik.
hypothesis: Babarapa kakanakan liar sudah dikurung ulih urang (biasanya urang tuha buhannya sorang); dalam babarapa kasus paninggalan kakanakan ngini disababakan ulih panulak matan urang tuha ka cacat intelektual atawa fisik kakanakan nang parah.

source: Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away.
reference: Kakanakan liar ngini bisa suah mangalami panyiksaan nang barat atawa trauma sabalum ditalantarakan atawa malariakan diri.
hypothesis: Anak liar mungkin sudah ma'alami pelecehan anak nang parah atawa trauma sabalum ditinggalakan atawa kabur.

source: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.
reference: Nang lainnya diduga suah digaduh ulih binatang; ada jua nang madahi suah hidup di alam liar.
hypothesis: Nang lain disambat sudah diganalakan oleh binatang; ada nang disambat sudah hidup di alam bebas saurang.

source: When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans.
reference: Mun dasar bujur digaduh ulih binatang nang kada manyarupai manusia, kakanak liar tadi manampaiakan kabiasaan (dalam katarbatasan pisik) parak manyarupai binatang nang manggaduh inya.
hypothesis: Pas ditinggali oleh binatang lain, anak liar manunjukakan parilaku (dalam batas fisik) nang hampir sama lawan binatang nang diurus, kaya takutan atawa kada paduli lawan manusia.

source: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond.
reference: Samantara pambalajaran badasarakan pruyek maulah pambalajaran nang labih nyaman wan mamikat, cara scaffolding gasan malangkah labih jauh.
hypothesis: Walaupun pembelajaran berbasis proyek harus membuat belajar lebih mudah dan lebih menarik, perancah melangkah lebih jauh.

source: Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project.
reference: Cara Scaffolding lainan cara pambalajaran tapi labih ka bantuan nang manyadiakan bantuan gasan urang-urang nang lagi mampalajari pangalaman hanyar nangkaya prugram kumputer hanyar atawa handak mamulai pruyek hanyar.
hypothesis: Perancah bukanlah metode pembelajaran tapi lebih merupakan bantuan nang memberikan dukungan kepada individu nang sedang menjalani pengalaman belajar baru seperti menggunakan program komputer baru atau memulai proyek baru.

source: Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office.
reference: Scaffolds kawa kaduduanya, pirtual wan nyata, intinya tu, guru ngitu bantuk Scaffolds tapi kayaitu jua lakian panggapit kartas di Microsoft Office.
hypothesis: Scaffold bisa jadi virtual dan nyata, dengan kata lain, seorang guru adalah bentuk scaffold tapi begitu jua dengan manusia penjepit kertas kecil di Microsoft Office.

source: Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
reference: Karangka Pirtual tagabung dalam parangkat lenak wan dimaksutakan gasan manakuni, manyuruh, wan manjalasakan tata cara nang bisa jadi ngalih gasan digawi siswa saurangan.
hypothesis: Virtual Scaffolds diinternalisasi dalam perangkat lunak wan dimaksudakan gasan mempertanyakan, mendorong, wan manjalasakan prosedur nang mungkin terlalu menantang gasan siswa gasan menangani saurangan.

source: Children are placed in Foster Care for a wide variety of reasons that range from neglect, to abuse, and even to extortion.
reference: Bamacam-macam alasan kakanakan diandak di Rumah Asuh mulai matan ditalantarakan, disiksa, bahkan jua pamarasan anak.
hypothesis: Anak-anak diandak di Foster Care gasan bamacam alasan nang bamacam-macam mulai dari pengabaian, sampai panyiksaan, wan bahkan pemerasan.

source: No child should ever have to grow up in an environment that is not nurturing, caring, and educational, but they do.
reference: Kadada kanakan nang harus hidup di lingkungan nang kada mandidik, kada manggaduhinya, wan kada bapandidikan, tapi kada wan buhannya.
hypothesis: Kadada kakanakan nang harus tumbuh di lingkungan nang kada manyayangi, peduli, wan mendidik, tapi bubuhannya harus.

source: We perceive the Foster Care System to be a safety zone for these children.
reference: Kami marasa Tataan Rumah Asuh ngini wadah nang aman gasan buhan kanakan ngini.
hypothesis: Kami malihat Sistem Pengasuhan jadi zona aman gasan kakanakan ini.

source: Our foster care system is supposed to provide safe homes, loving caregivers, stable education, and reliable health care.
reference: Tataan asuh kami manyadiakan rumah nang aman, pangasuh nang sayang, pandidikan nang stabil, wan wadah kasihatan nang mamadai.
hypothesis: Sistem asuh kita seharusnya menyediakan rumah aman, pengasuh nang menyayangi, pendidikan nang stabil, dan perawatan kesehatan nang handal.

source: Foster care is supposed to provide all the necessities that were lacking in the home they were previously taken from.
reference: Rumah asuh batujuan manyadiakan sagala kabutuhan nang kada buhannya dapat di rumah sabalum diandak di sini.
hypothesis: Pangasuhan seharusnya menyediakan semua kebutuhan nang kurang di rumah nang sebelumnya diambil.

source: The Internet combines elements of both mass and interpersonal communication.
reference: Internet menggabung akan unsur-unsur komunikasi beramian wan interpersonal.
hypothesis: Internet manggabungakan unsur komunikasi massa wan interpersonal.

source: The distinct characteristics of the Internet lead to additional dimensions in terms of the uses and gratifications approach.
reference: Karakteristik nang beda darinya Internet maulah dimensi tambahan dalam hal pandakatan panggunaan wan gratifikasi.
hypothesis: Karakteristik Internet nang khas mengarah ke dimensi tambahan dalam hal pendekatan penggunaan wan kepuasan.

source: For example, “learning” and “socialization” are suggested as important motivations for Internet use (James et al., 1995).
reference: Cuntuhnya, “balajar” wan “sosialisasi” disaranakan jadi motivasi panting gasan panggunaan Internet (James et al., 1995).
hypothesis: Misalnya, "belajar" dan "sosialisasi" disaranakan sebagai motivasi penting untuk penggunaan Internet (James et al., 1995).

source: “Personal involvement” and “continuing relationships” were also identified as new motivation aspects by Eighmey and McCord (1998) when they investigated audience reactions to websites.
reference: “Keterlibatan pribadi” wan “hubungan nang bekelanjutan” jua dikenali jadi aspek motivasi hanyar oleh Eighmey wan McCord (1998) pas buhannya menyelidiki reaksi buhan umum lawan situs web.
hypothesis: "Keterlibatan pribadi" dan "hubungan berkelanjutan" jua diidentifikasi sebagai aspek motivasi hanyar oleh Eighmey dan McCord (1998) pas buhannya menyelidiki reaksi penonton ke situs web.

source: The use of video recording has led to important discoveries in the interpretation of micro-expressions, facial movements which last a few milliseconds.
reference: Panggunaan parakam pidio manuntun kita ka panamuan-panamuan penting dalam maartiakan ekspresi-mikru, pagarakan muha nang sampai bamili-mili datik.
hypothesis: Penggunaan rekaman video sudah membawa pada penemuan penting dalam interpretasi ekspresi mikro, gerakan wajah nang berlangsung beberapa milidetik.

source: In particular, it is claimed that one can detect whether a person is lying by interpreting micro-expressions correctly.
reference: Hususnya, sampai ada nang kawa mangatahui inya ni bakaramput atawa kadanya liwat maartiakan eksprisi-mikru.
hypothesis: Khususnya, diklaim bahwa seseorang kawa mendeteksi apakah seseorang berbohong dengan menafsirkan ekspresi mikro dengan benar.

source: Oliver Sacks, in his paper The President's Speech, indicated how people who are unable to understand speech because of brain damage are nevertheless able to assess sincerity accurately.
reference: Oliver Sacks, dalam tulisan sidin Pidatu Prisidin, manyambat kayapa urang-urang nang kada kawa mamahami parkataan, nang sabab gangguan utak gin kawa manilai katulusan sacara parsis.
hypothesis: Oliver Sacks, dalam makalahnya The President's Speech, manunjukakan kayapa urang nang kada kawa memahami pidato karena karusakan otak tetap kawa menilai ketulusan secara akurat.

source: He even suggests that such abilities in interpreting human behavior may be shared by animals such as domestic dogs.
reference: Sidin jua manambahakan bahuwa kamampuan dalam maartiakan kabiasaan manusia bisa kawa dibagiakan matan binatang nangkaya anjing haraguan.
hypothesis: inya bahkan menyaranakan kemampuan dalam menafsirkan perilaku manusia mungkin dimiliki oleh hewan seperti anjing domestik.

source: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed.
reference: Panalitian abad ka dua puluh sudah manunjukakan bahuwa ada dua kalumpuk pariasi genetik: tasambunyi wan talihat.
hypothesis: Penelitian abad ke-20 telah menunjukakan bahwa ada dua kumpulan variasi genetik: tersembunyi lawan diekspresikan.

source: Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation.
reference: Parpindahah manambahi ragam genetik hanyar, wan pilihan mahapusnya matan ragam kalumpuk talihat.
hypothesis: Mutasi manambah variasi genetik hanyar, wan seleksi manghapusnya matan kumpulan variasi nang diekspresikan.

source: Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
reference: Pamisahan wan panyatuan ba’asa mambaurakan ragam bulang-bulik antara dua kalumpuk tadi wan tiap generasinya.
hypothesis: Segregasi wan rekombinasi mangganti variasi bolak-balik antara dua kolam lawan satiap generasi.

source: Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources.
reference: Di sabana, ngalih gasan primata nang baisi sistim pancarnaan mirip manusia gasan mamuasakan kabutuhan asam aminonya matan tanaman nang ada.
hypothesis: Di padang gurun, ngalih gasan primata lawan sistem pencernaan kaya manusia gasan memenuhi kebutuhan asam amino matan sumber daya tanaman nang tasadia.

source: Moreover, failure to do so has serious consequences: growth depression, malnutrition, and ultimately death.
reference: Apalagi, kagagalan manggawinya baakibat sarius: depresi partumbuhan, malnutrisi, wan akhirnya kamatian.
hypothesis: Salain itu, kagagalan malakukan itu baisi konsekuensi serius: kamunduran partumbuhan, malnutrisi, wan akhirnya kamatian.

source: The most readily accessible plant resources would have been the proteins accessible in leaves and legumes, but these are hard for primates like us to digest unless they are cooked.
reference: Sumber tanaman nang ada kawa manyadiakan protein ada di dadaunan wan kacang-kacangan, tapi ngini tu ngalih gasan buhan primata mancarna kacuali dimasak dahulu.
hypothesis: Sumber tanaman nang paling mudah diakses adalah protein nang kawa diakses di daun wan kacang-kacangan, tapi ini ngalih gasan primata kaya kita gasan mencerna kecuali dimasak.

source: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.
reference: Kabalikannya, makanan hiwani (samut, anai-anai, hintalu) kada ngalih dicarna, tapi ngitu tu jua manyadiakan protein dalam jumlah nang banyak nang mangandung samunyaan asam amino dasar.
hypothesis: Sabaliknya, makanan binatang (semut, rayap, telur) kada hanya mudah dicerna, tapi jua menyediakan protein dalam jumlah tinggi nang mengandung semua asam amino esensial.

source: All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their "protein problem" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today.
reference: Nang parlu dihatiakan, buhan kita kada usah takajut bila bubuhan laluhur kita manuntungakan "masalah prutiin" nya sama nangkaya apa nang buhan simpanse gawi di sabana wayahini.
hypothesis: Semua hal dipertimbangkan, kita kada harus heran amun nenek moyang kita sendiri memecahkan "masalah protein" mereka dengan cara nang sama kaya simpanse di padang rumput hari ini.

source: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes).
reference: Gangguan guring marupakan prusis bangun nang disinghaja salawas jam guring biasa wan habis tu guring lagi kaina (10–60 manit).
hypothesis: Gangguan tidur adalah proses sadar sadar nang disengaja salawas periode tidur normal wan turu sebentar imbahnya (1060 menit).

source: This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you.
reference: Ngini ni kawa digawi pakai alaram nang kada tapi nyaring gasan manyadarakan kita tapi kada bujur-bujur mambangunakan pian.
hypothesis: Ini kawa dengan mudah digawi lawan memakai jam alarm nang relatif tenang gasan meulah pian sadar tanpa meulah pian bangun.

source: If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off.
reference: Amun kita marasa mamatii alaramnya pas sambil guring, cubai andak alaramnya di sisi lain kita guring, ngini maulah kita mau kada mau babangun gasan mamatii.
hypothesis: Amun ikam maatur ulang jam pas lagi tidur, jam kawa diandak di subalah kamar, mamaksa ikam bangun matan ranjang gasan mamatikannya.

source: Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.
reference: Pilihan nang lainnya badasar biuritme parlu nginum banyak cairan (banyu atawa teh, nang maulah pangamihan) sabalum guring, maulah kita bangun gasan bakamih.
hypothesis: Pilihan lain nang didasarakan pada bioritme malibatakan minum banyak cairan (khususnya banyu atawa teh, diuretik nang dikenal) sabalum tidur, mamaksa urang bangun gasan buang air kecil.

source: The amount of inner peace a person possesses correlates oppositely to the amount of tension in one’s body and spirit.
reference: Jumlah kadamaian batin nang urang bisi baraitan tabalik tahadap jumlah katagangan dalam awak wan jiwa sasaurang.
hypothesis: Jumlah kedamaian batin nang dimiliki seseorang berkorelasi lawan jumlah ketegangan dalam tubuh dan jiwa seseorang.

source: The lower the tension, the more positive the life force present. Every person has the potential to find absolute peace and contentment.
reference: Samakin randah katagangannya, samakin pusitip kakuatan hidup hadir. Satiap urang bisi kamungkinan gasan manamuakan kadamaian wan kapuasan sapanuhnya.
hypothesis: Semakin randah takanan, semakin positif daya hidup nang ada. satiap urang baisi potensi gasan manamuakan kedamaian wan kepuasan mutlak.

source: Everyone can achieve enlightenment. The only thing standing in the way of this goal is our own tension and negativity.
reference: Tiap urang kawa mandapat pancarahan. Sabuting ja nang jadi panghalang tujuan ngini, yato katagangan wan kanigatipan kita surang.
hypothesis: setiap orang bisa mencapai pencerahan. satu-satunya hal yg menghalangi tujuan ini adalah ketegangan dan negatifitas kita sendiri.

source: The Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of Buddha, but were extended by the mahayana path of love and by a lot of techniques from Indian Yoga.
reference: Agama Budha Tibet badasarakan pangajaran Budha, tapi ditambahi ulih jalan cinta Mahayana wan banyak tehnik-tehnik matan Yoga India.
hypothesis: Buddhisme Tibet didasarkan pada ajaran Buddha, tapi diperluas oleh jalan cinta mahayana dan banyak teknik dari Yoga India.

source: In principle the Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It consists of Kundalini Yoga, meditation and the path of all-embracing love.
reference: Pada prinsipnya agama Budha Tibet ngini sadarhana banar. Prinsipnya ngini tadiri dari Yoga Kundalini, miditasi, wan jalan mancintai kasaluruhan.
hypothesis: Pada prinsipnya Buddhisme Tibet sangat sederhana.

source: With Kundalini Yoga the Kundalini energy (enlightenment energy) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras and visualizations.
reference: Wan Kundalini Yoga energi Kundalini (energi pancarahan) bangun malalui garakan yoga, malatih pahinakan, tawar, panglihatan.
hypothesis: Lawan Kundalini Yoga energi Kundalini (energi pencerahan) dihidangkan malalui postur yoga, latihan napas, mantra wan visualisasi.

source: The center of Tibetan meditation is the Deity Yoga. Through the visualization of various deities the energy channels are cleaned, the chakras are activated and the enlightenment consciousness is created.
reference: Pusat meditasi Tibet ngitu Yoga Diwa. Malalui panglihatan bamacam-macam diwa saluran energi dibarasihiakan, tanaga dalam aktip wan kasadaran pancarahan tabantuk.
hypothesis: Pusat meditasi Tibet adalah Yoga Dewa. Melalui visualisasi berbagai dewa saluran energi dibersihkan, cakra diaktifkan dan kesadaran pencerahan diciptakan.

source: Germany was a common enemy in World War 2, leading to cooperation between the USSR and USA. With the end of the war the clashes of system, process and culture led to the countries falling out.
reference: Jerman ngini tu musuh barataan nagara di Perang Dunia 2, maulah tajadinya karjasama antara Uni Soviet wan Amerika Serikat. Wan tuntungnya perang, bintrukan sistim, pruses, wan budaya manuju ka kajatuhan nagara-nagara.
hypothesis: Jerman adalah musuh umum dalam Perang Dunia 2, nang manyabapakan kerjasama antara USSR wan AS.

source: With two years of the end of the war, the former allies were now enemies and the Cold War began.
reference: Tuntungnya perang dua tahun, bakas sakutu-sakutu wahini bamusuh pulang wan bamulai Perang Dingin.
hypothesis: Dua tahun imbah perang, bekas sekutu wahini jadi musuh wan Perang Dingin dimulai.

source: It was to last for the next 40 years and would be fought for real, by proxy armies, on battlefields from Africa to Asia, in Afghanistan, Cuba and many other places.
reference: Ngini tuh balangsung sampai 40 tahun ka muka wan diparjuangakan sacara nyata, ulih tantara parwakilan, di midan partampuran matan Afrika sampai Asia, di Afganistan, Kuba, wan di wadah-wadah lain jua.
hypothesis: Perang ngini akan balangsung salawas 40 tahun salanjutnya wan akan tarjadi sacara nyata, lawan pasukan proksi, di medan perang matan Afrika sampai Asia, di Afghanistan, Kuba wan banyak wadah lainnya.

source: By September 17, 1939, the Polish defense was already broken, and the only hope was to retreat and reorganise along the Romanian bridgehead.
reference: Tanggal 17 September 1939, partahanan urang Pulandia hancur, wan harapannya babaya manyarah wan baatur baasa wan markas Rumania.
hypothesis: Pas tanggal 17 September 1939, pertahanan Polandia sudah patah, wan satu-satunya harapan adalah mundur wan maatur ulang sapanjang kapala jembatan Rumania.

source: However, these plans were rendered obsolete nearly overnight, when over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet's Union Red Army entered and created the Belarussian and Ukrainian fronts after invading the eastern regions of Poland in violation of the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international treaties, both bilateral and multilateral.
reference: Katia, rancana ngini sudah dianggap jabuk dalam samalam haja, pas 800,000 tantara matan Tantara Habang Uni Soviet masuk wan maulah Belarusia wan Ukraina saling bahadapan imbah manyarbu daerah timur Polandia nang malanggar Parjanjian Damai Riga, Parjanjian Non-Agresi Soviet-Pulandia, wan parjanjian-parjanjian internasiunal lainnya, nang bilateral maupun multilateral.
hypothesis: Namun, rencana ngini jadi kada tapakai hampir samalam, pas labih dari 800.000 tentara matan Uni Soviet Tentara Merah masuk wan maulah front Belarusia wan Ukraina imbah manyarang wilayah timur Polandia nang malanggar Perjanjian Perdamaian Riga, Pakta Non-Agresi Soviet-Polandia, wan perjanjian internasional lainnya, baik bilateral maupun multilateral.

source: Using ships to transport goods is by far the most efficient way to move large amounts of people and goods across oceans.
reference: Mamakai kapal gasan mangirim barang-barang cara paling pas gasan mangirim barang-barang wan urang nang dalam jumlah ganal manyubarangi lautan.
hypothesis: mamakai kapal gasan mambawa barang adalah cara nang paling efisien gasan manggarakakan banyak urang wan barang malalui lautan.

source: The job of navies has traditionally been to ensure that your country maintains the ability to move your people and goods, while at the same time, interfering with your enemy's ability to move his people and goods.
reference: Gawian bubuhan angkatan laut ngitu mamastiakan bahuwa nagara ikam manjaga kamampuan mangirim barang-barang wan urang kita, sambil jua, mahalang-halangi kamampuan musuh gasan mangirim barang-barang wan urangnya.
hypothesis: tugas angkatan laut secara tradisional adalah memastikan bahwa negara kalian mempertahankan kemampuan memindahkan orang dan barang kalian, sementara pada saat yang sama, mengganggu kemampuan musuh kalian untuk memindahkan orang dan barangnya.

source: One of the most noteworthy recent examples of this was the North Atlantic campaign of WWII. The Americans were trying to move men and materials across the Atlantic Ocean to help Britain.
reference: Salah sabuting cuntuh nang paling penting hahanyaran ngini yato kampanye Atlantik Utara Perang Dunia Kadua. Bubuhan Amerika mancuba pulang mangirim urang-urangnya wan bahan-bahan manyubarangi Samudera Atlantik gasan manukungi Inggris.
hypothesis: Salah satu contoh nang paling terkenal adalah kampanye Atlantik Utara Perang Dunia II. Amerika mencoba memindahkan manusia dan material melintasi Samudra Atlantik gasan membantu Inggris.

source: At the same time, the German navy, using mainly U-boats, was trying to stop this traffic.
reference: Di wayah nang sama, Angkatan Laut Jerman, kabanyakan mamakai U-boat, mancoba maampihi jalur pahangkutan ngini.
hypothesis: Pas saat nang sama, angkatan laut Jerman, mamakai kapal selam U, mencoba gasan menghentikan lalu lintas ini.

source: Had the Allies failed, Germany probably would have been able to conquer Britain as it had the rest of Europe.
reference: Saandainya Sakutu kada barhasil, Jerman kikira cagar kawa manundukakan Inggris nang kaya negara Eropa lainnya.
hypothesis: Amun Sekutu gagal, Jerman mungkin kawa menaklukakan Inggris kaya nang dilakukannya di Eropa lainnya.

source: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.
reference: Kambing pinanya pamulaan diternakakan kisaran 10.000 tahun nang lalu di Pegunungan Zagros Iran.
hypothesis: Kambing pinanya sudah dijinakkan partama kali kira-kira 10.000 tahun nang lalu di Pagunungan Zagros Iran.

source: Ancient cultures and tribes began to keep them for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and skins.
reference: Budaya bahari wan suku mamulai maingu buhannya gasan maambil susu, rambut, daging, wan kulitnya.
hypothesis: Budaya wan suku bahari mulai memelihara buhannya gasan akses nang nyaman ke susu, rambut, daging, wan kulit.

source: Domestic goats were generally kept in herds that wandered on hills or other grazing areas, often tended by goatherds who were frequently children or adolescents, similar to the more widely known shepherd. These methods of herding are still used today.
reference: Kambing lokal biasanya diingu dalam kawanan nang bakaliyaran di pabukitan atawa daerah-daerah gembalaan nang lain, rancak digaduhi uleh gembala kambing nang kabanyakannya tuh kakanakan atawa remaja, mahirip lawan gembala nang dikenal rajin. Cara beingu ngini masih dipakai sampai wayah ngini.
hypothesis: Kambing domestik umumnya disimpan dalam kawanan nang bajalan di bukit atawa daerah penggembalaan lainnya, rancak dijaga oleh penggembala kambing nang rancak anak-anak atawa remaja, mirip lawan penggembala nang labih dikenal.

source: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.
reference: Jalur kereta dibangun di Inggris pas pamulaan abad 16.
hypothesis: Wagonway dibangun di Inggris pas awal abad ke-16.

source: Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day.
reference: Biar gerbong cuma matan papan kayu basambung, mambariakan buhan kuda manariknya gasan mancapai kalajuan tartinggi lawan manarik bawaan nang taganal pada di jalanan nang kasar saban hari.
hypothesis: Walaupun jalan kareta hanya tadiri dari papan kayu paralel, jalan ngini mamungkinakan kuda nang maangkatnya mancapai kacepatan nang labih ganal wan maangkat muatan nang labih ganal pada jalan nang labih kasar wayah itu.

source: Crossties were introduced fairly early to hold the tracks in place. Gradually, however, it was realised that tracks would be more efficient if they had a stip of iron on the top.
reference: Ikatan silang dikanalakan tadahulu gasan manahani rel sakira kada bagarak. Sacara betahap, katia sadar amun rel kawa labih apik lagi bila di atasnya ada batang wasi.
hypothesis: Crossties diulah gasan manyimpan rel di wadahnya. tatapi, secara batahap, diitihi bahwa rel akan labih efisien amun baisi stip besi di atas.

source: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.
reference: Ngini jadi pacobaan nang umum, tapi wasi maulah roda kayu gerbongnya labih aus.
hypothesis: Ngini jadi praktik umum, tapi besi manyababakan labih banyak karusakan pada roda kayu dari gerobak.

source: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.
reference: Makanya, ban kayu diganti lawan ban wasi. Di tahun 1767, rel wasi pamulaan dikanalakan.
hypothesis: Akhirnya, roda kayu diganti lawan roda besi. pas tahun 1767, rel besi pertama diperkenalkan.

source: The first known transportation was walking, humans began walking upright two million years ago with the emergence of Homo Erectus (meaning upright man).
reference: Pamulaannya nang kita tahu transportasi tu bajalan haja, manusia kawa cagat bajalan dari dua juta tahun nang lalu lawan muncul Homo Erectus (baarti manusia cagat).
hypothesis: Transportasi nang paling pamulaan adalah bajalan, manusia mulai bajalan tagak dua juta tahun nang lalu lawan timbulnya Homo Erectus (baarti manusia tagak).

source: Their predecessors, the Australopithecus did not walk upright as habitually.
reference: Pandahulu buhannya, Australopitekus kada cagat bajalan nang kaya rajin.
hypothesis: pendahulunya, Australopithecus kada bejalan tegak kaya biasanya.

source: Bipedal specializations are found in Australopithecus fossils from 4.2-3.9 million years ago, although Sahelanthropus may have walked on two legs as early as seven million years ago.
reference: Spesialisasi Bipedal ditamuakan pada fosil Australopitekus matan 4,2-3,9 juta tahun lalu, biar Sahelanthropus sudah kawa bajalan lawan dua batis saawal-awalnya wayah tujuh juta tahun nang lalu.
hypothesis: Spesialisasi bipedal ditamuakan dalam fosil Australopithecus matan 4,2-3,9 juta tahun nang lalu, walaupun Sahelanthropus mungkin sudah bajalan di atas dua batis pas tujuh juta tahun nang lalu.

source: We can start living more friendly to the environment, we can join to the environmental movement, and we can even be activists in order to reduce the future suffering in some degree.
reference: Kita kawa mamulai hidup ramah lingkungan lagi, kita kawa bagabung lawan gerakan lingkungan, wan kita juwa kawa jadi aktipis gasan mangurangi darita masa depan.
hypothesis: Kita kawa mulai hidup lebih ramah lingkungan, kita kawa bergabung lawan gerakan lingkungan, dan kita bahkan kawa jadi aktivis gasan mengurangi penderitaan di masa depan.

source: This is just like symptomatic treatment in many cases. However, if we do not only want a temporary solution, then we should find the root of the problems, and we should deactivate them.
reference: Ngini tu nangkaya gajala perlakuan di kabanyakan kasus-kasus. Lalu, amun kita kada cuma handak solusi setumat, kita mustinya manamuakan akar masalahnya, wan kita musti tolak juwa.
hypothesis: ini sama aja kaya pengobatan gejala dalam banyak kasus. tapi kalo kita ga mau hanya solusi sementara, kita harus mencari akar masalahnya, dan kita harus menonaktifkannya.

source: It is obvious enough that the world has changed much because of humankind's scientific and technological advancements, and problems have become greater because of overpopulation and mankind's extravagant lifestyle.
reference: Nyata banar sudah amun dunia sudah baubah banyak banar sabab kamajuan pangatahuan wan teknologi umat manusia, lawan masalah-masalah sudah talanjur ganal banar sabab penduduk nang balabihan wan gaya hidup manusia nang balabihan.
hypothesis: Sudah cukup jelas bahwa dunia sudah banyak berubah karena kemajuan ilmiah dan teknologi manusia, dan masalah sudah jadi lebih besar karena kelebihan populasi dan gaya hidup manusia yang mewah.

source: After its adoption by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft signed by the President of Congress John Hancock and the Secretary Charles Thomson was then sent a few blocks away to the printing shop of John Dunlap.
reference: Imbah diadopsi uleh Kongres tanggal 4 Juli, draf batulis tangan nang ditandatangani ulih Presiden Kongres John Hancock wan Sekretaris Charles Thomson imbah ngitu dikirim babarapa blok ka toko parcitakannya si John Dunlap.
hypothesis: Imbah disatujui ulih Kongres pas 4 Juli, sabuah rancangan tulisan tangan nang ditandatangani ulih Presiden Kongres John Hancock wan Sekretaris Charles Thomson imbahtu dikirim beberapa blok jauhnya ka toko cetak John Dunlap.

source: Through the night between 150 and 200 copies were made, now known as "Dunlap broadsides".
reference: Samalaman antara 150 sampai 200 salinan diulah, wayah ngini dikanal wan "Dunlap broadsides".
hypothesis: Salawas malam antara 150 wan 200 salinan diulah, wayah ini dipinandui sabagai "Dunlap broadsides".

source: The first public reading of the document was by John Nixon in the yard of Independence Hall on July 8.
reference: Pambacaan umum pamulaan dokumen ngitu uleh si John Nixon di halaman Independence Hall tanggal 8 Juli.
hypothesis: Pembacaan publik pertama dokumen ngitu oleh John Nixon di halaman Independence Hall pas tanggal 8 Juli.

source: One was sent to George Washington on July 6, who had it read to his troops in New York on July 9. A copy reached London on August 10.
reference: Sabuting sudah dikirim ka wadah George Washington tanggal 6 Juli, nang sudah mambacaakan gasan pasukannya di New York tanggal 9 Juli. Sabuting salinan sampai di London tanggal 10 Agustus.
hypothesis: Sabuting dikirim ka George Washington pas 6 Juli, nang membacanya gasan pasukannya di New York pas 9 Juli. Sabuting salinan sampai di London pas 10 Agustus.

source: The 25 Dunlap broadsides still known to exist are the oldest surviving copies of the document. The original handwritten copy has not survived.
reference: 25 Dunlap broadsides nang dikatahui masih ada sampai wayah ni ngitu ialah salinan dokumen nang paling lawas bartahan. Salinan nang batulis tangan sudah kadada lagi.
hypothesis: 25 lembar Dunlap nang masih diketahui ada adalah salinan tertua dari dokumen ini.

source: Many paleontologists today believe that one group of dinosaurs survived and is alive today. We call them birds.
reference: Banyak buhan ahli paleontologi wayah ni parcaya sabuting kalumpuk dinosaurus ngitu salamat wan hidup sampai wayah ngini. Iya nang kita sambat buhannya burung.
hypothesis: Banyak ahli paleontologi wahini parcaya bahuwa satu kalompok dinosaurus batahan hidup sampai wahini.

source: Many people don't think about them as dinosaurs because they have feathers and can fly.
reference: Banyak urang nang kada tahu buhannya ngitu dinosaurus juwa sabab buhannya baisi bulu wan kawa tarabang.
hypothesis: Banyak urang kada bapikir buhannya tu dinosaurus karana buhannya baisi bulu wan kawa tarabang.

source: But there are a lot of things about birds that still look like a dinosaur.
reference: Tapi banyak banar di burung ngitu nang masih haja kalihatan kaya dinosaurus.
hypothesis: Tapi banyak hal tentang burung yang masih kelihatan kayak dinosaurus.

source: They have feet with scales and claws, they lay eggs, and they walk on their two back legs like a T-Rex.
reference: Buhannya baisi batis nang basisik wan bakarukut, buhannya bahintalu, wan buhannya bajalan wan batis balakang nang kaya T-Rex.
hypothesis: Buhannya baisi batis lawan sisik wan cakar, buhannya batalua, wan buhannya bajalan lawan dua batis balakang kaya T-Rex.

source: Virtually all computers in use today are based on the manipulation of information which is coded in the form of binary numbers.
reference: Pada hakekatnya sabarataan komputer nang dipakai wayah ngini ngitu dasarnya ialah akalan inpurmasi nang diulahi kode matan nomor biner.
hypothesis: Hampir seberataan komputer nang dipakai wahini didasarakan pada manipulasi informasi nang dikodekan dalam bentuk angka biner.

source: A binary number can have only one of two values, i.e. 0 or 1, and these numbers are referred to as binary digits - or bits, to use computer jargon.
reference: Sabuting nomor biner kawa baisi sabuting haja matan dua nilai, cuntuhnya 0 atawa 1, wan nomor ngini juwa dianggap sabagai angka biner - atawa tatakan, gasan mamakai bahasa komputer.
hypothesis: Bilangan biner hanya kawa beisi satu dari dua nilai, yaitu 0 atawa 1, wan angka ini disambat digit biner - atawa bit, gasan memakai jargon komputer.

source: Internal poisoning may not be immediately apparent. Symptoms, such as vomiting are sufficiently general that an immediate diagnosis cannot be made.
reference: Karacunan dalam awak bujur haja kada langsung kalihatan. Gajala-gajala, nang kaya muak ngitu pananda amunnya pamariksaan kada kawa langsung digawi.
hypothesis: Keracunan internal mungkin kada langsung talihat. Gejala, kaya muntah cukup umum sahingga diagnosis langsung kada kawa diulah.

source: The best indication of internal poisoning may be the presence of an open container of medication or toxic household chemicals.
reference: Pananda karacunan dalam awak nang paling bagus ngitu adanya wadah obat nang tabuka atawa pakakas kimia rumahan nang baracun.
hypothesis: Tanda paling baik dari keracunan internal mungkin adalah adanya wadah obat atau bahan kimia rumah tangga beracun nang tabuka.

source: Check the label for specific first aid instructions for that specific poison.
reference: Lihati hulu ;abel gasan instruksi partolongan pamulaan nang spesifik juwa gasan jenis racunnya.
hypothesis: Cek label gasan instruksi pertolongan pertama khusus gasan racun tertentu.

source: The term bug is used by entomologists in a formal sense for this group of insects.
reference: Istilah hama dipakai ulih entomologis dalam nalar purmal gasan kalumpuk karangga ngini.
hypothesis: Istilah bug dipakai ulih ahli entomologi dalam arti formal gasan kalompok serangga ngini.

source: This term derives from ancient familiarity with Bed-bugs, which are insects highly adapted to parasitize humans.
reference: Istilah naya barasal matan kakaluargaan tuha wan kutu tilam, nang mana marupakan karangga nang baadaptasi banar gasan memparasitakan manusia.
hypothesis: Istilah ngini baasal matan kabiasaan bahari lawan kutu ranjang, nang marupakan serangga nang sangat bapasitas pada manusia.

source: Both Assassin-bugs and Bed-bugs are nidicolous, adapted to living in nest or housing of their host.
reference: Kumbang pambunuh wan kutu tilam kaduanya sama-sama marupakan nidicolous, baadaptasi gasan hidup di sarang atawa barumah matan inangnya.
hypothesis: Kaduanya Assassin-bugs wan Bed-bugs adalah sarang, disesuaikan gasan hidup di sarang atawa rumah inang buhannya.

source: Across the United States of America, there are approximately 400,000 known cases of Multiple Sclerosis (MS), leaving it as the leading neurological disease in younger and middle aged adults.
reference: Di sapanjang Amerika Serikat, ada kikira 400.000 kasus nang dikatahui ngitu ngarannya Sklerosis Babanyak (SB), ngitu jadi panyakit neurologis paling banyak di umuran nang taanum wan urang tuha manangah.
hypothesis: Di seluruh Amerika Serikat, ada sekitar 400.000 kasus Multiple Sclerosis (MS) nang diketahui, menjadikannya sebagai penyakit neurologis utama pada dewasa muda dan pertengahan umur.

source: MS is a disease that affects the central nervous system, which is made up of the brain, the spinal cord and the optic nerve.
reference: MS ngitu panyakit nang manyakiti sistim saraf pusat, nang tamasuk matan utak, saraf tulang balakang wan saraf optik.
hypothesis: MS adalah panyakit nang mempengaruhi sistim saraf pusat, nang tadiri matan otak, sumsum tulang belakang wan saraf optik.

source: Research has found that females are two times more likely to have MS then males.
reference: Panilitian sudah manamuakan bahua di babinian ngitu kamungkinan tabanyak dua kali baisian MS daripada lalakian.
hypothesis: Penelitian sudah manamuakan bahwa binian dua kali labih mungkin baisi MS daripada lakian.

source: A couple may decide it is not in their best interest, or in the interest of their child, to raise a baby.
reference: Sapasang laki bini bulih mamutusakan kalu mengganalakan bayi ngitu lainan kainginan buhannya nang paling baik, atawa kainginan anak buhannya tadi.
hypothesis: Sepasang suami istri mungkin memutuskan itu bukan gasan kepentingan terbaik mereka, atau gasan kepentingan anak mereka, gasan membesarkan bayi.

source: These couples may choose to make an adoption plan for their baby.
reference: Pasangan-pasangan ngini bulih mamilih maulahakan rancana adopsi gasan bayi buhannya.
hypothesis: Pasangan ngini mungkin mamilih gasan maulah rencana adopsi gasan bayi buhannya.

source: In an adoption, the birth parents terminate their parental rights so that another couple may parent the child.
reference: Dalam pangadopsian, kuitan kandung mangakhiri hak buhannya sabagai kuitan sahingga pasangan nang lain kawa jadi kuitan gasan anaknya.
hypothesis: Dalam adopsi, urang tuha kandung maakhiri hak urang tuha buhannya supaya pasangan lain kawa ma'ulah anak.

source: Science’s main goal is to figure out the way the world works through the scientific method. This method in fact guides most scientific research.
reference: Tujuan utama sains ialah gasan mangatahui cara dunia bagawi malalui cara ilmiah. Mitudi ngini sabujurnya manuntun kabanyakan panalitian ilmiah.
hypothesis: Tujuan utama ilmu pengetahuan adalah mencari tahu cara dunia bekerja melalui metode ilmiah. Metode ini sebenarnya memandu sebagian besar penelitian ilmiah.

source: It isn’t alone though, experimentation, and an experiment is a test that is used to eliminate one or more of the possible hypotheses, asking questions, and making observations also guide scientific research.
reference: Tatapi kada ngitu saurangan haja, eksperimentasi, wan eksperimen ialah tes nang dipakai gasan mahilangakan sabuting atawa labih hipotesis nang mungkin, mangajuakan partanyaan, wan manggawi pangamatan wan jua manuntun panalitian ilmiah.
hypothesis: Kada saurangan, eksperimen, wan eksperimen adalah tes nang dipakai gasan menghilangkan satu atawa labih hipotesis nang mungkin, batakun, wan meulah pengamatan jua memandu penelitian ilmiah.

source: Naturalists and philosophers focused on classical texts and, in particular, on the Bible in Latin.
reference: Naturalis wan filusuf fokus lawan bacaan-bacaan klasik, khususnya lawan Alkitab dalam bahasa Latin.
hypothesis: Ahli alam wan filsuf bafokus pada teks klasik, khususnya Alkitab dalam bahasa Latin.

source: Accepted were Aristotle's views on all matters of science, including psychology.
reference: Nang ditarima ialah pandangan Aristoteles manganai sabarataan masalah ilmu pangatahuan, tamasuk psikologi.
hypothesis: Pandangan Aristoteles ditarima dalam seberataan hal ilmu pengetahuan, termasuk psikologi.

source: As knowledge of Greek declined, the West found itself cut off from its Greek philosophical and scientific roots.
reference: Pas pangatahuan manganai Yunani manurun, Barat mandapati dirinya taputus matan akar filusufis wan ilmiah Yunaninya.
hypothesis: Seiring pengetahuan tentang bahasa Yunani menurun, Barat mendapati dirinya terputus dari akar filsafat dan sains Yunani.

source: Many observed rhythms in physiology and behavior often crucially depend on the presence of endogenous cycles and their production through biological clocks.
reference: Banyak ritme nang diitihi dalam fisiologi wan parilaku rancak tuh bagantung banar lawan kabaradaan siklus endogen wan produksinya malalui jam biologis.
hypothesis: Banyak ritme nang diamati dalam fisiologi wan parilaku rancak bagantung lawan adanya siklus endogen wan produksi buhannya malalui jam biologis.

source: Periodic rhythms, which are not simply responses to external periodic cues, have been documented for most living beings, including bacteria, fungi, plants, and animals.
reference: Ritme periodik, nang lain sakadar respon lawan isyarat periodik eksternal, sudah didokumentasiakan gasan kabanyakan makhluk hidup, tamasuk bakteri, jamur, tumbuhan, wan binatang.
hypothesis: Ritme periodik, nang lain hanya tanggapan lawan isyarat periodik eksternal, sudah didokumentasiakan gasan sebagian besar makhluk hidup, termasuk bakteri, jamur, tanaman, wan satua.

source: Biological clocks are self sustaining oscillators which will continue a period of free-running cycling even in the absence of external cues.
reference: Jam biologis ialah osilator mandiri nang cagar malanjutakan periode siklus bajalan bibas bahkan tanpa adanya isyarat eksternal.
hypothesis: Jam biologis adalah osilator mandiri nang akan malanjutakan periode siklus bebas bahkan tanpa adanya isyarat eksternal.

source: The Hershey and Chase experiment was one of the leading suggestions that DNA was a genetic material.
reference: Eksperimen Hershey wan Chase ialah salah sabuting saran nang pamulaan bahuwa DNA ialah matiri genetik.
hypothesis: Eksperimen Hershey lawan Chase adalah salah satu saran utama bahwa DNA adalah materi genetik.

source: Hershey and Chase used phages, or viruses, to implant their own DNA into a bacterium.
reference: Hershey wan Chase mamakai fag, atawa virus, gasan mananamakan DNA buhannya saurang ka dalam bakteri.
hypothesis: Hershey lawan Chase memakai fag, atau virus, gasan menanam akan DNA buhannya ke dalam bakteri.

source: They did two experiments marking either the DNA in the phage with a radioactive phosphorus or the protein of the phage with radioactive sulfur.
reference: Buhannya manggawi dua parcubaan nang manandai DNA dalam fag lawan fosfor radioaktif atawa protein fag lawan belerang radioaktif.
hypothesis: buhannya meulah dua eksperimen menandai DNA di fag lawan fosfor radioaktif atau protein fag lawan belerang radioaktif.

source: Mutations can have a variety of different effects depending on the type of mutation, the significance of the piece of genetic material affected and whether the cells affected are germ-line cells.
reference: Mutasi kawa baisian macam-macam dampak nang balain-lain tagantung lawan janis mutasinya, signifikansi bagian materi genetik nang tapangaruh wan apakah sel nang tapangaruh ialah sel garis-benihnya.
hypothesis: Mutasi kawa baisi bamacam-macam efek tagantung lawan jenis mutasi, signifikansi potongan materi genetik nang tapangaruh wan apakah sel nang tapangaruh adalah sel germinal.

source: Only mutations in germ-line cells can be passed on to children, while mutations elsewhere can cause cell-death or cancer.
reference: Cuma mutasi di dalam sel garis-benih nang kawa diturunakan ka kakanakan, sadangkan mutasi di tampat lain kawa manyababakan kamatian sel atawa kanker.
hypothesis: Hanya mutasi di sel germinal nang kawa diturunakan ka anak, sedangkan mutasi di tempat lain kawa manyababakan kematian sel atawa kanker.

source: Nature-based tourism attracts people interested in visiting natural areas for the purpose of enjoying the scenery, including plant and animal wildlife.
reference: Pariwisata barbasis alam manarik urang-urang nang tartarik gasan mangunjungi daerah-daerah alam gasan manikmati pamandangan, temasuk tanaman wan binatang liar.
hypothesis: Pariwisata alam manarik urang nang katuju bakunjang ka kawasan alam gasan manikmati pemandangan, tamasuk satwa liar wan tumbuhan.

source: Examples of on-site activities include hunting, fishing, photography, bird watching, and visiting parks and studying information about the ecosystem.
reference: Cuntuh kagiatan di lapangan tarmasuk berburu, maunjun, mamoto, mangamati burung, wan mangunjungi taman wan mampalajari inpormasi tantang ekosistim.
hypothesis: Contoh kegiatan di situs tamasuk baburu, manangkap iwak, bafoto, manonton buruang, wan bakunjang ka taman wan mampalajari informasi tantang ekosistem.

source: An example is visiting, photographing, and learning about organgatuangs in Borneo.
reference: Cuntuhnya ialah mangunjungi, mamoto, wan balajar tantang orangutan di Borneo.
hypothesis: Contohnya adalah bakunjang, maambil gambar, wan balajar pasal organgatuang di Kalimantan.

source: Every morning, people leave small country towns in cars to go their workplace and are passed by others whose work destination is the place they have just left.
reference: Satiap pagi, urang-urang maninggalakan kota halus di padesaan pakai mobil gasan tulak ka wadah begawi buhannya wan dilalui ulih urang lain nang hanyar bulik dari wadah bagawinya.
hypothesis: Setiap pagi, urang maninggalakan kota halus di dusun wan mobil gasan ka wadah gawian buhannya wan dilalui oleh urang lain nang tujuan gawiannya adalah wadah nang hanyar buhannya tinggalakan.

source: In this dynamic transport shuttle everyone is somehow connected with, and supporting, a transport system based on private cars.
reference: Dalam kandaraan bulang-bulik nang dinamis ngini satiap urang entah kaya apa tahubung, wan mandukung, sistim kandaraan bardasarkan mobil sorangan.
hypothesis: Dalam dinamika transportasi ini, setiap urang entah bagaimana terhubung lawan, lawan mendukung, sistem transportasi berdasarkan mobil pribadi.

source: Science now indicates that this massive carbon economy has dislodged the biosphere from one of its stable states that has supported human evolution for the past two million years.
reference: Ilmu pangatahuan wahini manunjukan bahuwa ekonomi karbon ganal ngini sudah malapasakan biosper matan salah sabuting kondisi stabil nang talah mandukung parubahan manusia salama dua juta tahun tarakhir.
hypothesis: ilmu pengetahuan wahini menunjukakan bahwa ekonomi karbon nang ganal ini sudah menggusur biosfer dari salah satu keadaan stabilnya nang telah mendukung evolusi manusia selama dua juta tahun terakhir.

source: Everyone participates in society and uses transportation systems. Almost everyone complains about transportation systems.
reference: Barataan urang talibat dalam masyarakat wan manggunakan sistim transpurtasi. Parak samuaan urang mangaluh tantang sistim transpurtasi.
hypothesis: setiap urang berpartisipasi dalam masyarakat dan memakai sistem transportasi. hampir setiap orang mengeluh tentang sistem transportasi.

source: In developed countries you seldom hear similar levels of complaints about water quality or bridges falling down.
reference: Di nagara barkambang Pian jarang mandangar kaluhan nang tingkatannya sama tantang kualitas banyu atawa jumbatan runtuh.
hypothesis: Di nagara maju jarang banar tadangar keluhan nang sama tentang kualitas banyu atawa jembatan nang runtuh.

source: Why do transportation systems engender such complaints, why do they fail on a daily basis? Are transportation engineers just incompetent? Or is something more fundamental going on?
reference: Kanapa sistim transpurtasi mandapatakan kaluhan nang kaya ngitu, kanapa satiap hari sistim transpurtasi gagal? Apa teknisi transpurtasi kada mampu? Atawa sasuatu nang labih mandasar lagi tajadi?
hypothesis: kenapa sistem transportasi meulah keluhan nang kaya itu, kenapa sistemnya gagal setiap hari? apa insinyur transportasi kada becus? atau ada sesuatu nang lebih mendasar terjadi?

source: Traffic Flow is the study of the movement of individual drivers and vehicles between two points and the interactions they make with one another.
reference: Arus lalu lintas ngitu mampalajari tantang pargarakan masing-masing pangamudi wan kandaraan antara dua titik wan hubungan nang buhannya lakukan satu sama lain.
hypothesis: Aliran Lalu Lintas adalah studi tentang pergerakan sopir wan kendaraan individu antara dua titik wan interaksi nang buhannya lakukan satu sama lain.

source: Unfortunately, studying traffic flow is difficult because driver behavior cannot be predicted with one-hundred percent certainty.
reference: Sayangnya, mampalajari arus lalu lintas liwar ngalih sabab parilaku pangamudi kada kawa ditangguhi lawan kapastian saratus persen.
hypothesis: Sayangnya, mempelajari arus lalu lintas ngalih karena perilaku sopir kada kawa diprediksi lawan kepastian seratus persen.

source: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave within a reasonably consistent range; thus, traffic streams tend to have some reasonable consistency and can be roughly represented mathematically.
reference: Untungnya, buhan pangandara candarung baparilaku sampai kisaran nang cukup sama; sabab ngitu, arus lalu lintas candarung bisi kasamaan nang kuat wan kikira kawa ditunjukakan sacara matematis.
hypothesis: Untungnya, supir cenderung beperilaku dalam kisaran nang cukup konsisten; jadi, aliran lalu lintas cenderung beisi konsistensi nang cukup dan dapat diwakili secara kasar secara matematis.

source: To better represent traffic flow, relationships have been established between the three main characteristics: (1) flow, (2) density, and (3) velocity.
reference: Gasan manunjukakan arus lalu lintas nang tabagus, hubungan-hubungan talah tarjalin antara talu karakteristik utama: (1) aliran, (2) kapadatan, wan (3) kalajuan.
hypothesis: Gasan labih baik mawakilakan aliran lalu lintas, hubungan sudah diulah antara talu karakteristik utama: (1) aliran, (2) kapadatan, wan (3) kacepatan.

source: These relationships help in planning, design, and operations of roadway facilities.
reference: Hubungan-hubungan ngini manulung dalam parancanaan, parancangan, wan uperasi-uperasi sarana jalan raya.
hypothesis: Hubungan ngini manolongi dalam parancanaan, desain, wan operasi fasilitas jalanan.

source: Insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly helped them evade enemies more easily and find food and mates more efficiently.
reference: Sarangga ngitu binatang pamulaan nang mangudara. Kamampuan buhannya gasan tarabang manulung buhannya mahindari musuh labih mudah wan manamuakan makanan wan pasangan labih efisien.
hypothesis: Serangga adalah binatang pertama nang terbang. Kemampuan terbangnya membantu buhannya menghindari musuh dengan lebih mudah dan mencari makanan dan pasangan dengan lebih efisien.

source: Most insects have the advantage of being able to fold their wings back along the body.
reference: Kabanyakan sarangga mamiliki kauntungan gasan kawa malipat sayapnya ka balakang di sapanjangan awak.
hypothesis: Kabanyakan serangga baisi kauntungan kawa melipatakan sayapnya balakang sapanjang awak.

source: This gives them a wider range of small places to hide from predators.
reference: Hal ngini mambari buhannya jangkauan nang labih luas matan wadah-wadah halus gasan batabun matan pamangsa.
hypothesis: Ngini mambari buhannya wadah nang labih luas gasan manyambunyiakan diri matan predator.

source: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.
reference: Wayah ngini, sabuting sarangga nang kada kawa malipat ka balakang sayapnya tu capung wan lalat capung.
hypothesis: wayahini, satu-satunya serangga nang kada kawa melipat balik sayapnya adalah lalat naga wan lalat hari.

source: Thousands of years ago, a man called Aristarchus said that the Solar System moved around the Sun.
reference: Ribuan waktu nang lalu, sorang lakian bangaran Aristarchus manyambat amun Sistim Tata Surya bagarak mangalilingi Matahari.
hypothesis: ribuan tahun lalu, seorang pria bernama Aristarchus mengatakan bahwa tata surya bergerak mengelilingi matahari.

source: Some people thought he was right but many people believed the opposite; that the Solar System moved around the Earth, including the Sun (and even the other stars).
reference: Babarapa urang bapikir inya bujur tapi banyak urang parcaya sabaliknya; amun Sistim Tata Surya bagarak mangalilingi Bumi, tamasuk Matahari (wan bahkan bintang-bintang nang lain).
hypothesis: Beberapa urang bapikir inya bujur tapi banyak urang nang bapikir sabaliknya; bahwa Tata Surya bagarak di sakitar Bumi, tamasuk Matahari (wan bahkan bintang lainnya).

source: This seems sensible, because the Earth doesn't feel as if it's moving, does it?
reference: Hal ngini kaliatan masuk akal, sabab Bumi kada karasa solah-olah bagarak, ya lo?
hypothesis: Ini nampak masuk akal, karena bumi kada terasa seolah-olah bergerak, iya kada?

source: The Amazon River is the second longest and the biggest river on Earth. It carries more than 8 times as much water as the second biggest river.
reference: Sungai Amazon ngini tu sungai pamanjangnya kadua wan pangganalnya di Bumi. Sungai ini mambawa labih matan 8 kali labih hibak banyu dibandingakan sungai pangganalnya kadua.
hypothesis: Sungai Amazon adalah sungai kadua tapanjang wan paling ganal di Bumi. Sungai ngini mambawa banyu labih matan 8 kali labih banyak pada sungai kadua pangganalnya.

source: The Amazon is also the widest river on Earth, at times six miles wide.
reference: Amazon juwa sungai paluasnya di Bumi, takananya lebarnya anam mil.
hypothesis: Amazon jua sungai terlebar di Bumi, kadang-kadang lebar enam mil.

source: A full 20 percent of the water that pours out of the planet's rivers into the oceans comes from the Amazon.
reference: Sabanyak 20 parsen matan banyu nang mangalir matan sungai di planet ngini ka lautan baasal matan Amazon.
hypothesis: 20 persen banyu nang mengalir dari sungai ke lautan datang dari Amazon.

source: The main Amazon River is 6,387 km (3,980 miles). It collects water from thousands of smaller rivers.
reference: Sungai Amazon ngini 6.387 km (3.980 mil). Sungai ngini mangumpulakan banyu matan ribuan sungai-sungai halus.
hypothesis: Sungai Amazon nang utama baisi panjang 6.387 km (3.980 mil). Sungai ngini mangumpulakan banyu matan ribuan sungai halus.

source: Although pyramid-building in stone continued until the end of the Old Kingdom, the pyramids of Giza were never surpassed in their size and the technical excellence of their construction.
reference: Biar bangunan piramida batu dilanjutakan sampai habis Karajaan Lawas, piramida-piramida Giza kada suah malangkahi ukuran wan kaunggulan tiknis konstruksi buhannya.
hypothesis: Maskipun pambangunan piramida batu tarus dilanjutakan sampai akhir Karajaan Lama, piramida Giza kada pernah dilampaui dalam ukuran wan kaunggulan teknis pambangunan buhannya.

source: New Kingdom ancient Egyptians marvelled at their predecessors monuments, which were then well over a thousand year old.
reference: Karajaan hanyar Mesir bahari tekajut lawan monumen-monumen babuyutan buhannya, nang pas ngitu baumur saribu tahun lawasnya.
hypothesis: Urang Mesir kuno Kerajaan Baru kagum lawan monumen pendahulunya, nang wayah itu sudah labih dari saribu tahun.

source: Vatican City's population is around 800. It is the smallest independent country in the world and the country with the lowest population.
reference: Populasi kota Vatikan sakitar 800. Ngini tu nagara mardeka tehalus di dunia wan nagara lawan populasi tarendeh.
hypothesis: Populasi Kota Vatikan sakitar 800 jiwa. Negara ngini adalah nagara independen tahalus di dunia wan nagara lawan populasi paling randah.

source: Vatican City uses Italian in its legislation and official communications.
reference: Kota Vatikan mamakai bahasa Italia dalam undang-undang wan komunikasi rasminya.
hypothesis: Kota Vatikan mamakai bahasa Italia dalam parundang-undangan wan komunikasi rasmi.

source: Italian is also the everyday language used by most of those who work in the state while Latin is often used in religious ceremonies.
reference: Bahasa Italia juwa ialah bahasa sahari-hari nang dipakai kabanyakan buhannya nang begawi di nagara bagian ngitu samantara bahasa Latin rancak dipakai dalam upacara kaagamaan.
hypothesis: Bahasa Italia jua marupakan bahasa sehari-hari nang dipakai oleh sabagian besar urang nang bagawi di nagara bagian samantara bahasa Latin rancak dipakai dalam upacara keagamaan.

source: All citizens of Vatican City are Roman Catholic.
reference: Sabarataan warga Kota Vatikan ialah Katolik Roma.
hypothesis: Sabarataan warga Kota Vatikan adalah Katolik Roma.

source: People have known about basic chemical elements such as gold, silver, and copper from antiquity, as these can all be discovered in nature in native form and are relatively simple to mine with primitive tools.
reference: Urang sudah mangatahui tentang unsur-unsur kimia dasar kaya amas, perak, wan tambaga matan jaman bahari, sabab sabarataan ngini ditamuakan di alam dalam bantuk asli wan relatip sadarhana gasan ditambang lawan alat-alat primitip.
hypothesis: Urang sudah tahu soal unsur kimia dasar kaya emas, perak, wan tembaga matan zaman kuno, karena ini kawa ditamuakan di alam dalam bentuk asli wan relatif sederhana gasan ditambang lawan alat primitif.

source: Aristotle, a philosopher, theorised that everything is made up of a mixture of one or more of four elements. They were earth, water, air, and fire.
reference: Aristoteles, saurang filusuf, bateori bahuwa sabarataan diulah matan sabuah campuran matan sabuting atawa labih matan ampat elemen. Buhannya tu bumi, banyu, udara, wan api.
hypothesis: Aristoteles, seorang filsuf, berteori bahwa segala sesuatu terbuat dari campuran satu atau lebih dari empat elemen.

source: This was more like the four states of matter (in the same order): solid, liquid, gas, and plasma, though he also theorised that they change into new substances to form what we see.
